sources.title: 白蚁学
sources.notes: 全文存于 _unpublished/文库/白蚁学（885410 字符），抽取：未知；文本由原书 DOCX/PDF 抽取或 OCR 而来，不是原书：拉丁学名、性别词尾、图注可能损坏，正式引用前须核对纸本或原书 PDF；中文教材，7 篇 22 章。

evidence.quote: 缺少真工蚁的低等白蚁在发育到成虫的过程中，前胸腺经历了相当规律的生长过程
evidence.locator: 001-200.txt 第 383 行（卷内页码未标）
evidence.note: 支撑：低等白蚁缺少真工蚁、与白蚁科分野的生理背景（v5 段 700–702）；本书列于文末文献。

evidence.quote: 胫节的边缘常生有1排硬刺(spine),在胫节 的末端有2或3枚胫节刺，称为端距(tibialspur)
evidence.note: 支撑：tibial spur=端距 的显式定义；据此定规范译名「端距/端距式」，改「胫距/胫距式」。OCR 原样（跑节=跗节）。

evidence.quote: 乳白蚁的雄性有1对针突，雌性缺针突。第10腹片中间分开，在两侧缘上有尾须
evidence.note: 支撑：针突=stylus 旧译；据此统一为「刺突」。

evidence.quote: 针突（styli）短，不超过腹部
evidence.note: 支撑：针突=styli 旧译；据此统一为「刺突」。
支撑：胫距=端距 的异译；据此改「端距式」。

evidence.quote: 等翅目最早定名的属是白蚁属Termes,由林奈于1758年定名。早期定名的属还有木白蚁属Kalotermes、草白蚁属Hodotermes、鼻白蚁属Rhinotermes、洞白蚁属、胄白蚁属，它们均由Hagen命名，前3属命名于1853年，后2属命名于1858年。
evidence.note: 支撑：Termes 1758、Kalotermes/Hodotermes/Rhinotermes 1853 等命名史

evidence.quote: 低龄的、不具外生翅芽、头部无兵蚁形态、不能独立进食的未成熟个体，又称为依 赖性幼蚁、无翅若虫。
evidence.note: 支撑：幼蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 拟工蚁又称为假工蚁(falseworker),它可独自取食，具翅芽，但翅芽明显缩短或逐 渐消失。
evidence.note: 支撑：拟工蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 由幼蚁发育而来，外部形态保持原始状态的一类成熟个体。
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 前兵蚁又称为先兵、前兵、白兵(whitesoldier)、未成熟兵蚁(callowsoldier),它是 具有兵蚁头部形态、全身没有色素、全身没有高度骨化的个体。前兵蚁没有保卫能力。
evidence.note: 支撑：前兵蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 白蚁群体内头部形态明显改变且高度骨化、具有典型防御性特征的一类成熟个体。 该品级特化的防御性形态特征有：加长的上顎、塞子状的头部和额腺能释放大量防御分 泌物。一般情况下，兵蚁的头部颜色较深，骨化程度较高。兵蚁不能蜕皮且永远不育。
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 若蚁又称为具翅若蚁(brachypterous nymph),它是白蚁群体发展到一定阶段，由幼 蚁发育而来、具有外生翅芽的一类未成熟个体。
evidence.note: 支撑：若蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 成熟的白蚁群体内，由若蚁完成最后一次蜕皮发育成胸部着生两对完整长翅、具有 较深色素的一类成熟个体。
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 有翅成虫脱落四翅后，留有翅鳞的虫体。
evidence.note: 支撑：脱翅成虫（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 原始繁殖蚁是指建立蚁群的蚁后和蚁王，它们由有翅成虫脱翅而成。
evidence.note: 支撑：原始繁殖蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 次级繁殖蚁是从白蚁群体中产生的、没有经历分飞过程的繁殖蚁。它们不独自经历 危险的分飞过程，而保留在它们的母巢中或母群体中(或者从它们的母群中产生芽裂)， 并因此得到其巢中其他品级协助。而原始繁殖蚁在刚配对时，除了彼此帮助外，没有其 他品级的帮助。
evidence.note: 支撑：次级繁殖蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 成蚁型补充繁殖蚁是成熟的群体中产生的有翅成虫，它不经历分飞，仍留在母巢 (natal nest)中，在母巢中脱翅
evidence.note: 支撑：成蚁型补充繁殖蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 没有真正工蚁的白蚁群体，如木白蚁科、古白蚁科、胄白蚁科、齿白蚁科以及鼻白 蚁科原鼻白蚁属白蚁，其幼态型补充繁殖蚁分为以下3种类型。
evidence.note: 支撑：幼态型补充繁殖蚁（无真正工蚁类群）（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 无翅型补充繁殖蚁(apterousneotenic)：没有翅芽的补充繁殖蚁。根据来源将此 型补充繁殖蚁分为幼蚁型补充繁殖蚁(larvoid)和拟工蚁型补充繁殖蚁(pseudergatoid)
evidence.note: 支撑：无翅型补充繁殖蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 兵蚁型补充繁殖蚁(reproductivesoldier)：外部形态似兵蚁、具有繁殖功能的雌 雄性个体。这种补充繁殖蚁仅存在于古白蚁科
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁型补充繁殖蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 若蚁型补充繁殖蚁(nymphoid)：从若蚁转化而来、保留翅芽的补充繁殖蚁。
evidence.note: 支撑：若蚁型补充繁殖蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 职蚁型补充繁殖蚁(ergatoid)：从工蚁转化而来、没有翅芽的补充繁殖蚁。
evidence.note: 支撑：职蚁型补充繁殖蚁（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 单块型白蚁群体中存在拟工蚁，拟工蚁可以进行渐进性蜕皮发育成若蚁，若蚁再发 育成有翅成虫；
evidence.note: 支撑：单块型发育路径（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 多块型白蚁（达尔文澳白蚁除外）群体中被喂养的幼蚁可以直接经过若蚁阶段发育 成有翅成虫（经历若蚁线路），若蚁和有翅成虫可以分别发育成若蚁型补充繁殖蚁 （nymphoid）和成蚁型补充繁殖蚁（adultoid）。幼蚁也可以直接发育成工蚁和前兵蚁（经 历无翅线路）。前兵蚊可发育成兵蚁，工蚁可发育成职蚁型补充繁殖蚁。在白蚁科象白 蚁亚科，部分工蚁可以发育成前兵蚁，再发育成兵蚁
evidence.note: 支撑：多块型发育路径（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 从Myles （1999）综述中可以得知，白蚁科是可以产生补充型繁殖蚁的。大白蚁属有 的种类（如勇猛大白蚁）就可以产生成蚁型补充繁殖蚁，而近明大白蚁就不产生任何补 充型；土白蚁属中胖身土白蚁能产生成蚁型补充繁殖蚁，同为土白蚁属的Odontotermes assmuthi就不产生任何补充型。
evidence.note: 支撑：大白蚁属/土白蚁属补充繁殖蚁异质性（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: Miura和Matsumoto （1995, 1998a）对分布于印度 尼西亚婆罗洲的中黄须白蚁进行深入研究。这种白蚁具有三型（大、中、小）工蚁一型 兵蚁，其中中工蚁、大工蚁是雌性，而小工蚁、兵蚁是雄性，且小工蚊可以通过前兵蚁 阶段发育成兵蚁。
evidence.note: 支撑：中黄须白蚁品级与行为多型（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 黑翅土白蚁在我国白蚁学研究中占有重要地位，因为它是危害我国堤坝的最主要白 蚁种类。关于该白蚁是否能产生补充型繁殖蚁这一问题一直存在争论，大多数学者都认 为这种白蚁没有补充型繁殖蚁。
evidence.note: 支撑：黑翅土白蚁补充型争论（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章品级表与说明段）

evidence.quote: 白蚁的蜕皮有3种方式：渐进性蜕皮 （progressive moult）、静止性蜕皮（stationary moult）和倒退性蜕皮（regressive moult）
evidence.note: 支撑：三种蜕皮方式（渐进性/静止性/倒退性）及英文名（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章发育路径段）

evidence.quote: 倒退性蜕皮是白蚁特有的蜕皮方式，它使白蚁倒退回上一龄期。
evidence.note: 支撑：倒退性蜕皮的定义（v5《白蚁基础知识》第一章发育路径段）

evidence.quote: 分离出弗氏柠檬酸杆菌Citrobacterfreundii的固氮菌株
evidence.note: 支撑：French 等（1976）从达尔文澳白蚁、乳色乳白蚁与破坏象白蚁肠道分离出固氮菌株，用于 mastotermes-darwiniensis / coptotermes-lacteus / nasutitermes-exitiosus 三页

evidence.quote: 台湾乳白蚁蚁巢的含水量为30%〜37%,平均含水量为33.3%
evidence.note: 支撑：coptotermes-formosanus 蚁巢含水量

evidence.quote: 刘源智等(2002a)发现黑胸散白蚁的发育路径相当复杂，在其发育和分化过程中，发现有假工蚁(pseudo-worker)和假若蚁(pseudo-nymphs)的存在，并且繁殖类型有原始繁殖蚊、翅鳞型(scalereplacementreproductives)、长翅芽型(long-wingbudreplacementreproductives)、短翅芽型(short-wingbudreplacementreproductives)、微翅芽型(miniwingbudreplacementreproductives)和无翅型补充繁殖蚁(no-wingbudreplacementreproductives)等，还发现了兵蚁拟补充型繁殖蚁和工蚁拟补充型繁殖蚁。刘源智等(2002a,2002b)认为黑胸散白蚁的胚后发育主要包括2个龄期的幼蚁期、6个以上龄期的工蚁期、4个龄期的若蚁期和有翅成虫。幼蚊在第2次蜕皮后就分支出若蚁路线和无翅路线。无翅路线中各龄工蚁均可转化为前兵蚁，再发育成兵蚁；各龄工蚁也可发育成无翅型补充繁殖蚁。老龄工蚁还可发育成假工蚁，假工蚁可进一步发育成微翅型补充繁殖蚊。若蚁路线中低龄若蚁可以发育成短翅型补充繁殖蚁，或通过发育成假若蚁，进而发育成微翅型补充繁殖蚁；末龄若蚁发育成有翅成虫，也可发育成翅鳞型补充繁殖蚁或长翅型补充繁殖蚁。
evidence.note: 支撑：黑胸散白蚁补充繁殖蚁的翅发育型别（翅鳞型/长翅芽型/短翅芽型/微翅芽型/无翅型）

evidence.quote: 谢磊等(2011)用18SrDNA文库限制片长多态(RFLP)分析了来自上海的台湾乳白蚁工蚁的肠道鞭毛虫，测得每头工蚁的肠道内平均含有伪披发虫(780±179)头，全鞭毛虫(1630±391)头和旋披发虫(2950±1003)头，该结果与表9.1中的三种鞭毛虫在来自日本的台湾乳白蚁肠道内的总数基本一致。
evidence.note: 支撑：台湾乳白蚁工蚁肠道三种鞭毛虫的平均数量（谢磊等 2011）

evidence.quote: 台湾乳白蚁有翅成虫复眼小眼数为300〜400个，其中雌性成虫的复眼直径为(429±21)卩m,雄性成虫复眼直径为(360±35)卩m,雌蚁复眼略大于雄蚁。胡剑等(2009)发现，黑翅土白蚁成虫复眼各小眼晶锥直径约为12卩m,视杆直径为9卩m,有翅成虫每个复眼小眼数为360个左右。黑翅土白蚁在光适应条件状态时，屈光器及视杆细胞周围的色素颗粒主要分布在视杆部位的上侧；在暗适应条件状态时，则较均匀地分布于视杆细胞两侧上下。此外，性别对色素颗粒分布无明显影响。
evidence.note: 支撑：台湾乳白蚁有翅成虫复眼小眼数与雌雄复眼直径（张琳等 2005）

evidence.quote: 张琳等(2001)测试了台湾乳白蚁有翅成虫在分飞期间对3种发光二极管(lightemittingdiode,LED)和3种常用路灯(复金属灯、水银灯、高压钠灯)的趋性。结果发现，3种发光二极管发出的色光照射到水面的反射光，所诱集到的台湾乳白蚁有翅成虫，蓝色光(367〜583nm)与绿色光(525~648nm)显著多于红色光(600~733nm)。3种路灯诱集到的有翅成虫，以复金属灯最多，水银灯其次，若包裹防紫外线滤膜后，则此两种灯光诱集到的有翅成虫数量显著减少，又以复金属灯的诱集效应锐减最为显著，甚至少于水银灯；而高压钠灯则不论有无包裹防紫外线滤膜，均极显著少于复金属灯及水银灯，此结果与室内试验结果相符。此试验显示3种路灯对分飞的台湾乳白蚁有翅成虫诱集效果差异极为显著，且紫外线对台湾乳白蚁有翅成虫的诱集效应亦极为显著。张琳等(2001)推测短波长的光对台湾乳白蚁有翅成虫的诱集效果最佳。
evidence.note: 支撑：台湾乳白蚁有翅成虫对蓝光/绿光与红光的趋性差异、三种路灯诱集量差异（张琳等 2001）

evidence.quote: 黑翅土白蚁的主巢通常保持在24〜26C。当冬季周围土温降至9〜16°C,其巢内温度稍低，但也不低于20C。在夏季，当周围土温超过40°C时，其巢温一般仍不超过28°Co由于黑翅土白蚁主巢位于地表下1〜2m处，它们通过一定的调节作用能保持蚁巢冬暖夏凉。不过环境温度的过低或过高，仍会影响白蚁的外出觅食活动。
evidence.note: 支撑：黑翅土白蚁主巢温度 24〜26 ℃ 与冬夏缓冲

evidence.quote: Kulis等(2008)的实验表明，格斯特乳白蚁的存活率和行为受到湿度的影响。该白蚁喜好高湿度。它的取食量和生存率与湿度显著相关。5%的低湿度对格斯特乳白蚁有害。当相对湿度低于90%时，白蚁的取食活动下降。在相对湿度为84%时，它们存活时间少于21天；当相对湿度低于74%时，所有的白蚁都在7天内死亡。
evidence.note: 支撑：格斯特乳白蚁对湿度的依赖（Kulis 等 2008）

evidence.quote: Ferreira和Scheffrahn(2011)对麻头堆砂白蚁的有翅成虫趋光性、脱翅成虫的避光性进行了试验。结果发现，光的强度对麻头堆砂白蚁的有翅成虫吸引力不一样，它们喜欢飞向高光强的地方；而已脱翅的成虫则喜欢在黑暗的栖息地筑巢。这一结果具有应用价值，在防治麻头堆砂白蚁时，可以用高强度的光诱杀其有翅成虫。
evidence.note: 支撑：麻头堆砂白蚁有翅成虫趋高光强、脱翅成虫喜黑暗筑巢（Ferreira & Scheffrahn 2011）

evidence.quote: Cabrera和Rust（1996）针对小楹白蚁若蚁对光的反应进行了研究，在日光灯或白炽灯照射下，该白蚁的若蚁愿意躲藏到培养皿的有遮盖的部分下面；而用红色暗房灯时，则若蚁对这种光没有明显的选择性。
evidence.note: 支撑：小楹白蚁若蚁避光（Cabrera & Rust 1996）

evidence.quote: 巴西的Guaraldo和Costa・Leonardo(2009)在实验室中以格斯特乳白蚁为试验对象，将幼年的群体进行融合试验。她们将10个群体分成5组进行试验，每个群体中都只有1个蚁王和1个蚁后。结果发现：这些幼年的群体并没有发生激烈的战斗，15天后，两个蚁王中总有1个蚁王死亡（群体只保留了1个蚁王），80%的蚁后均得以保留（5组实验中只有1组中死亡1个蚁后）（表19.11）o
evidence.note: 支撑：格斯特乳白蚁幼年群体融合后只留 1 头蚁王、80% 蚁后保留（Guaraldo & Costa-Leonardo 2009）

evidence.quote: 广义的拟工蚁或假工蚁，定义为个体作为一种 功能分类完成工作，而其余的发展灵活。其区分于真工蚁的后期特征是产生了早期的 和不可逆转的发展分支，失去了继续分化为有翅蚁的可能。
evidence.locator: 第 6 章 Roisin & Korb / 101-200.txt 第 371 行
evidence.note: 支撑：真工蚁定义（v5 段 700）；引文中的空格为文库 OCR 原样。

evidence.quote: 达尔文澳白蚁Mastotermes darwiniensis的发育图中存在工蚁和若蚁两条支路
evidence.note: 支撑：澳白蚁科有真工蚁（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: 没有真 工蚁分化途径，因此个体被划分为广义的拟工蚁。
evidence.note: 支撑：原鼻白蚁属（沙白蚁科）无真工蚁（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: 杆白蚁属的品级体系几乎是未知的
evidence.note: 支撑：杆白蚁属品级未知（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: 从系统发育来说，兵蚁是所有生活白蚁的祖先的基础血统一次进化而来。
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁单次起源（v5 段 706）

evidence.quote: 存在所谓的兵蚁源繁殖蚁(Myles 1986),更恰当的称呼是类兵 蚁补充繁殖蚁(Roisin 2000)
evidence.note: 支撑：类兵蚁补充繁殖蚁（v5 段 706）

evidence.quote: 这些是否为真工蚁尚不能确定
evidence.note: 支撑：沙白蚁属真工蚁未定（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: 成熟雄 虫通常在第九腹板的末端具有一对针突(styli)(不分节)，但依据种类不同有所变化。
evidence.note: 支撑：针突(styli)=stylus 旧译；据此统一为「刺突」。

evidence.quote: 如麻头堆砂白蚁Cryptotermes brevis, Light(1931)认为它起源于中国，但Emerson(1936)认为加勒比海地区为其自然范围。Gay(1969)同意Emerson的观点
evidence.note: 支撑：cryptotermes-brevis 原产地之争

evidence.quote: 暴露于绿僵菌的独居湿木白蚁个体感病的速率(2〜6d)要显著快于处于类似环境条件下群居的白蚁(10头或25头)。同时，相对于独居的白蚁个体，群居白蚁的致死率下降了90%
evidence.note: 支撑：zootermopsis-angusticollis 群体免疫（Rosengaus 等 1998b）

evidence.quote: 已经有4个基因通过RNA干扰技术被成功沉默，分别是Hex, 和 Hex-2 (Zhou et al. 2006a, 2006c, 2007b, 2008), Cell-1
evidence.note: 支撑：reticulitermes-flavipes RNAi 沉默

evidence.quote: 血淋巴蛋白也与保幼激素的作用及白蚁的品级分化有着不可分割的关系
evidence.note: 支撑：reticulitermes-flavipes 储存蛋白连接营养与保幼激素信号

evidence.note: 支撑：翅鳞前后比例（v5 形态篇翅节）

evidence.quote: 草白蚁科的跗节分离不完整，由腹面看为5节，由背面看仅4节。
evidence.note: 支撑：跗节分节（v5 段 226）；该书“草白蚁科”为旧广义，含原白蚁属。

evidence.quote: 每侧卵巢的卵巢小管数仅7—10条
evidence.locator: 001-100.txt 第 309 行（雌性生殖系统）
evidence.note: 支撑：卵巢管数随类群变化（v5 段 511）

evidence.quote: 还有不少种类，同一巢蚁的工蚁，其体形大小有很大区别，具有两型或三型，土垅大白蚁 Macrotermes annandalei (Silvestri)、黄翅大白蚁 M. barneyi Light 同一群休内都有大工蚁和小工蚁之分
evidence.locator: 001-100.txt 第 344 行（非生殖型·工蚁品级）
evidence.note: 支撑：二型/多型工蚁见于 Macrotermes（土垅大白蚁、黄翅大白蚁），而非 Termes。OCR 原文『同一群休内』＝『同一群体内』。

evidence.quote: 兵蚁一般只有一类，但是在某些类群中，如大白蚁属 Macrotermes、小白蚁属 Microtermes 等，其兵蚁有大兵蚁和小兵蚁之分。
evidence.locator: 001-100.txt 第 349 行（非生殖型·兵蚁品级）
evidence.note: 支撑：二型兵蚁见于 Macrotermes、Microtermes，而非 Termes。

evidence.quote: 兵蚁  通常有大、小两类体形，或大、中、 小三类体形。
evidence.note: 支撑：大白蚁属 Macrotermes 兵蚁通常二型、部分三型——站点描述已正确

evidence.quote: 图360 箕头大白蚁 M. declivatus 大兵：1.头及胸背板背面；4.头侧面；7.后颏；10.上颚；13.触角；中兵：2.头及胸背板背面；5.头侧面；8.后颏；11.上颚；14.触角；小兵：3.头及胸背板背面；6.头侧面；9.后颏；12.上颚；15.触角。(仿朱世模)
evidence.note: 支撑：箕头大白蚁 Macrotermes declivatus 为三型兵蚁种（大兵+中兵+小兵）

evidence.quote:
大兵蚁  头黄色，象鼻黄色带褐。 头 、胸部几无毛，鼻端具数根毛， 腹部背板被少
量细短毛。
头宽大于长，宽圆形，两侧圆形凸出，后缘宽圆，触角13节，第3节2倍或甚长 于2节，上颚尖刺极小。前胸背板马鞍状，前半部直立。胫节距2:2:2。跗节4节。
小兵蚁  色泽、毛序、头型均似大兵蚁。 上颚尖刺极小，多数仅呈点状，触角12 节。胫距2:2:2。跗节4节。
evidence.note: 支撑：华象白蚁属 Sinonasutitermes 属级大兵蚁+小兵蚁（二型）——站点 diagnosis「兵蚁二型（个别种三型）」的前半依据
支撑：华象白蚁属分种检索表首条「兵蚁大、中、小三型」——个别种三型的检索依据

evidence.quote:
中兵蚁 体色稍淡。头扁圆形，宽大于长。鼻粗圆锥状，短于头长，侧观鼻伸向
前，端部低于头顶，鼻基似拱起，鼻夹角大于105°。触角13节，第2节最短，约为第
3 节之半，第4节稍长于2节。前胸背板前缘凹切甚浅。
小兵蚁 头长圆形，长大于宽，鼻短于头长，侧观鼻平伸向前，端部稍低于头顶，
鼻基平，鼻夹角约100°。触角12节，第2节最短，第3节1.5倍长于2节，第4节稍长 于 3 节 。前胸背板前后缘近平直(图526)。
evidence.note: 支撑：奇异华象白蚁 S. admirabilis 中兵蚁+小兵蚁（连同 927–930 大兵蚁成三型）

evidence.quote:
图534  三型华象白蚁 S.    trimorthus
兵蚁：1—3.大、中、小兵蚁头背面； 4—6 . 大 、中、小兵蚁头侧面； 7--9.大、中、小兵蚁上
颚；10 —12.大、中、小兵蚁前胸背板；13—15.大、中、小兵蚁触角；
工蚁：16.上颚。(仿李桂祥等)
evidence.note: 支撑：三型华象白蚁 S. trimorphus 图 534 大、中、小兵蚁（三型）

evidence.quote: 工蚁  单型或二型。头具稀疏毛，宽圆形，触角窝后部最宽，囟圆形凹坑，位于T 形缝交叉点正后方，后唇基隆起， 触角14 — 15节。 前胸背板较宽，前缘中央凹入。后 足胫节较短。
evidence.note: 支撑：夏氏白蚁属 Xiaitermes 工蚁「单型或二型」；原站点只写工蚁，漏了兵蚁品级

evidence.quote:
1. 兵蚁大小二型，大兵蚁头长连象鼻1 .96—2.10(2.03)mm,   头长不连鼻1.10 —1.25(1.16)mm,    头 宽1.24—1.45(1.41)mm,  前胸背板宽0.67—0.76(0.72)mm  …   … 藓县夏氏白蚁 X.yinxianensis
2. 兵蚁单型，头长连象鼻1.72—1.90(1.80)     mm,   头长不连鼻0.94—1.05(0.98)mm, 头宽1.04—1.12 (1.08)mm,       前胸背板宽0.55—0.59(0.57)mm …     …       … … … ·      天台夏氏白蚁 X.    tiantaiensis
evidence.note: 支撑：夏氏白蚁属分种检索表——鄞县夏氏白蚁 yinxianensis 兵蚁大小二型、天台夏氏白蚁 tiantaiensis 兵蚁单型（OCR「藓县」=「鄞县」）。据此站点 soldier 补「兵蚁单型或二型」
支撑：鄞县夏氏白蚁图 489 大兵蚁+小兵蚁+大工蚁+小工蚁（兵蚁二型、工蚁二型）

evidence.quote:
兵蚁具二态：
大兵  头形较短宽，似方形，囟圆形，开口位于两触角窝之间，孔口前方具纵沟伸 达唇端；上颚强壮，粗或扁宽，前部较内弯，左上颚内缘具2枚大齿，右上颚内缘具2 枚齿(或第2枚缘齿能见稍突出的齿痕迹)。上唇颇短宽，两侧近中部稍突出，呈六边 形，前沿中央略凹，端部具透明区，沿前缘具一排刷状短毛。触角16—17节。
小兵  头形稍狭长，凶圆形，开 口 ，位 于触角窝之间，孔口前方具纵沟伸至唇端； 上颚较细直，仅端部略弯，左上颚内缘具2枚缘齿，右上颚内缘具1枚缘齿；上唇较狭  长，两侧中部略收缩呈腰，端部透明区中央略凹，凹口两侧呈圆弧形两叶，沿前缘具一  排刷状短毛，唇端伸过或伸达近颚端；触角13—16节。
evidence.note: 支撑：棘白蚁属 Schedorhinotermes 属级「兵蚁具二态」大兵+小兵（二型，站点正确）。OCR「凶圆形」=「囟圆形」

evidence.quote: 胫节侧缘常生一列硬刺，末端有2—3枚端距
evidence.note: 支撑：端距=规范译名；据此改「胫距」。同段末「木白蚁科有些种类有爪间突」支撑 arolium=爪间突。

evidence.quote: 在一些原始的白蚁雄虫中，其第9腹板 后缘中部常有1对不分节的刺突
evidence.note: 支撑：刺突=stylus 规范译名；据此改「针突/腹刺」。

evidence.quote: 第7腹板(或称下 阴片，生殖板或亚生殖板等)延长
evidence.note: 支撑：下阴片/生殖板/亚生殖板 同物异名；据此 subgenital plate=下阴片，改「生殖板」。

evidence.quote: 胫节有3个端距，跗节4节。
evidence.note: 支撑：端距=胫节末端距（「胫节有3个端距」）；据此改「胫距」。

evidence.quote: 胫距式：3:3:3;跗节4节。
evidence.note: 支撑：胫距式=端距式 异译；据此改「端距式」。

evidence.quote: 雄虫具单节腹刺，雌虫缺腹刺，尾须2节。
evidence.note: 支撑：腹刺=stylus 旧译；据此统一为「刺突」。

evidence.quote: 1969年在浙江宁海县力洋区委所在地发现了不知名的木白蚁危害，疑是原房主1937年从香港带回的衣箱中传进的

乳白蚁从分飞后配对的有翅成虫开始，到产生下一代有翅成虫需要8—10年的时间。也 就是说，8—10年的巢龄是台湾乳白蚁的成熟时期。

evidence.quote: 台湾乳白蚁地上巢位于木材或树干内，虽然受  外界影响较大，但巢内温度仍然相当稳定。
evidence.note: 支撑：巢筑于木材或树干内，巢温稳定（巢温高于室温约 4 ℃ 见第 699 行）

evidence.quote: 在台湾乳  白蚁和黑翅土白蚁中都曾发现在离开蚁巢30m 以外的地点进行活动。如果以30m 为 半  径计算，则一个大巢群的活动面积，可达到2827 .44m², 尽管活动范围可能还不止于  此，但是终究不能像独栖昆虫那样广阔，其次在巢外停留的时间虽缺具体资料的证明， 但从现象上看，是有一定时间限制的。例如从台湾乳白蚁巢内施药来看，在施药后，往  往得到消灭全群的结果。而且死蚁集中堆集在蚁巢，似乎台湾乳白蚁的巢外活动不超过  4 - 7 天 。
evidence.note: 支撑：离巢 30 m 外活动；30 m 半径面积 2827.44 m²；巢外活动不超过 4—7 天

evidence.note: 支撑：最适 25—30 ℃；−3 ℃ 7 天全部死亡

evidence.note: 支撑：巢内 CO₂ 一般 0.5%—6.5%

evidence.note: 支撑：肠内已知共生原生动物 3 种（OCR 将 Pseudotrichonympha 误作 Pseudotrichomympha）

evidence.quote:
在我国南方潮湿地 区，台湾乳白蚁巢内经常出现有3种螨，A cotyledon  lishimei  Sarnsinak ,Acotyledon     ab-   soloni  Samsinak 和 Hypoaspis    hrolyi  Samsinak.  这些紫色或白色的螨叮咬白蚁的头部和 身体，有时…头白蚁身上竟有十多头螨叮咬。这些螨吸吮白蚁体液，致使白蚁死亡。 一 般在衰弱巢群内更容易引起螨类的寄生。有人饲养福建散白蚁 Reticulitermes    fukienen-  sis  Light 中，发现数十头福建散白蚁全部被螨捕食致死。经细查有大小两种螨，大 者 为 木螨 Caloglyphus,    小者为菌螨Ancetus,    其中菌螨可能作用更大。除此之外， 一种菌螨 Anoetus     myrnicarum  (Schencher)     也能使 Reticulitermes      lacifugus 大量死亡。
在正常健壮蚁群中螨的数量很少，只是个别白蚁带1—2头螨，不会危及蚁群的生
evidence.note: 支撑：巢内常见 3 种螨；衰弱巢群螨数量增多，健壮群体仅 1—2 头

evidence.quote: 所以 台湾乳白蚁对于低温是有一定的忍受能力。 一月平均气温4℃和最低气温零下3—5℃时  都能生存。在10℃以下蛰伏不动，10—13℃仍基本不动，或偶有取食、走动；13— 17℃虽有正常取食活动，但较缓慢；17℃以上，活动和觅食正常。高温状态下又失去正  常，在恒温39—41℃,经2天，95%死亡；在35—37℃连续观察两个月均未见死亡。 可见台湾乳白蚁生活的温度范围是在10—37℃。不论在冬天还是夏季蚁巢内的温度一  般高于室内的温度，通常可高4℃左右。在广东省中部，如1月平均室温为15℃时，此 时平均巢温为19.8℃;7月份平均室温为19.9℃时，而平均巢温是23.4℃。
evidence.note: 支撑：10 ℃ 以下蛰伏、13—17 ℃ 取食缓慢、17 ℃ 以上正常；39—41 ℃ 2 天死亡 95%、35—37 ℃ 两个月未见死亡；生活温度范围 10—37 ℃；巢温一般高于室温约 4 ℃

evidence.quote:
Three of the four species of Acholotermes form a compact, well defined group with
many features in common. The fourth, A. epius, with a longer mixed segment and
reduced third apical spur of the fore tibia shows resemblances to Anenteotermes
and Astalotermes species. These are reflected in both the single linkage cluster
analysis and the principal co-ordinate plots (Text-fig. 339). Median sorting leaves
all four species together, with A. epius joining the group at a phenon level 10%
lower than the linkage between the other species, at the same level of affinity as
that of certain members of other genera.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/acholotermes/，四仅种中三种紧凑，第四种 A. epius 混合段较长、前胫第三距退化、与 Anenteotermes 及 Astalotermes 相近；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote:
This genus, represented so far by a single species, is clearly related to Astalotermes,
and particularly to A. comis sp. n. However, the position of the subsidiary marginal
tooth of the left mandible, and the distinctly shorter gut of the worker, are both
features resembling more primitive groups. The results of the various numerical
taxonomic analyses also separate Acidnotermes to such an extent that it must be
placed in a different genus. Its small size and mandible form combined distinguish
it from all other genera. The only overlap in size is found in Anenteotermes nanus
(Sjöstedt) but here the mandibles are distinctive in both castes, and the worker
with its long mixed segment of the gut, and armed enteric valve, presents no
problems.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/acidnotermes/，与 Astalotermes 尤近 A. comis、性状近原始、数值分类分得很开、仅与 Anenteotermes nanus 体型重叠；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote:
The characters given in the above diagnosis make this one of the easiest genera
to recognize. No other African genus completely lacks the third apical spur on the
fore tibia, and in the worker caste the very characteristic gut with the white mesenteric
‘ball’ is easily recognizable even in the unopened abdomen. The abdomen of the
worker is not dehiscent in this genus. The only other genera with an elongated
mixed segment are Aderitotermes and Anenteotermes, and in these the end of the
mesenteron is not dilated.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/adaiphrotermes/，前胫仅两枚端距、非洲无其他属如此、工蚁白色中肠球、腹部不裂开、另两属中肠末端不膨大

evidence.quote:
This genus is fairly readily recognized in the imago by the conspicuous fontanelle,
combined with the very short, fine, even silvery pilosity of the head capsule and the
large size. The only sympatric species with superficial similarity is Astratotermes
prosenus, and this is larger with uneven pilosity. In the worker caste, the elongated mixed segment distinguishes Aderitotermes from most other genera. Of the
two genera with this feature similarly developed, Adaiphrotermes has a swollen
end to the mesenteron, and only two apical spurs on the fore tibia. Anenteotermes
is smaller, and the enteric valve seating and armature is different.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/aderitotermes/，以显著囟+短匀银色毛被+大形识别、同域 Astratotermes prosenus 更大且毛被不匀、工蚁长混合段区别于多数属；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

This genus contains a single species, and is separated from Astalotermes chiefly

on account of the unique development of the enteric valve seating. In the multi-

variate similarity analysis, A. moretelae is placed close to Astalotermes empodius,

However, as in Acidnotermes, the subsidiary marginal tooth of the left mandible has scarcely emerged from behind the molar prominence. The gut of the worker is shorter than in most Astalotermes. In the
imago, the fontanelle is usually raised on a distinct bump, and the medial spot is
always raised on a second, more prominent bump. These features are found in
several other genera, and suggest that although the enteric valve seating is clearly
specialized, a number of probably ancestral characteristics have been retained.

evidence.quote:
This is again a monotypic genus, slightly related to Adynatotermes, and perhaps
to some species of Astalotermes, but readily recognizable by its long mandibular
apical teeth. In this respect it resembles the next genus, Acholotermes, but the
meso- and metanota of the imago are narrower, and the ocelli much more distant
from the compound eyes. In the worker, the enteric valve seating has a much

shorter neck, and is more ventral in the unopened abdomen. The only other genera
with equally long apical teeth are Asagarotermes and Amicotermes. In the imagos
these have the left subsidiary marginal tooth clear of the molar prominence, the
ocellus closer to the eye, and a more inflated postclypeus. The workers of these
genera each have uniquely characteristic enteric valve armature.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/aganotermes/，单型属、略近 Adynatotermes、端齿长；与 Acholotermes 比背板更狭单眼更远、工蚁肠瓣座颈更短更靠腹；与 Asagarotermes/Amicotermes 比副缘齿与单眼不同

ventral in position in unopened abdomen; internal cushions of enteric valve without armature,
surface scaly.

evidence.quote:
The characteristic enteric valve armature of the worker caste makes this genus
an easy one to recognize. A very few specimens of A. kilimandjaricus have been
found in which it was less well developed and could only be seen after mounting and
clearing, but in general the character can be seen at magnifications of around 100 x
unmounted, in alcohol. Only in Amalotermes is the enteric valve somewhat similarly
armed, but in this the small, brown-headed workers are distinctive, and the armature

of the valve is approximately radially symmetrical.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/alyscotermes/，肠瓣刺为该属最显著识别特征、约 100 倍酒精标本可见、仅 Amalotermes 略似但工蚁头小褐色且刺近辐射对称

of left mandible separated from molar prominence by deep notch in surface view, complex
ratio, La/Li.Lm, 6.42-12.75. Right mandible with apical and marginal teeth in line, anterior
edges of marginal teeth subequal or first slightly longer, complex ratio, Ra/Ri.Rm, 10.13-15.40.
Mesenteric junction with proctodeum diagonal, to right of malpighian knot. Enteric valve
seating distinctly two-lobed, sometimes with very weakly developed third, connected to second
pouch of proctodeum by definite neck, dorsolateral in unopened abdomen. Internal cushions
of enteric valve unequally developed, positions 1 and 2 retracted, 3 and 4 slightly longer,
produced through valve opening; all cushions armed with spines, minute in mesal third, small
to pronounced in distal third, protruding through valve opening, particularly in positions 3 and 4.

exception to this. The diagnoses given above clearly include so wide a range of

variation that they overlap to some extent with several other genera, particularly

in the imago caste. It will be noted from the keys to genera that imagos alone

unarmed enteric valve separates it from many monotypic genera, from Alyscotermes

sources.title: Revised systematic position of Nasutitermes brevipilus Emerson, 1925 (Isoptera: Termitidae: Nasutitermitinae) and the designation of Hyleotermes gen. nov.

evidence.quote: The head capsule Hyleotermes soldier is ovoid in dorsal view, has a long cylindrical nasus, lacks a constriction and long setae, and is covered with microscopic hairs. The mixed segment of the slightly dimorphic worker caste is very short and the enteric valve has six cushions of differing sizes, with each adorned with a few to dozens of narrow spines on conical bases.
evidence.note: 鉴别要点（兵蚁头壳卵形、圆柱形鼻、无缢缩无长刚毛；工蚁轻微二型、混合段短、肠瓣 6 瓣垫）

evidence.quote: Soldier. Monomorphic. In dorsal view, head capsule longer than wide, not constricted. Nasus elongate, subcylindrical.
evidence.note: 兵蚁（单型、头壳长大于宽、鼻近圆柱形）

evidence.quote: The Hyleotermes brevipilus soldier is closest to soldiers of Ereymatermes Constantino, 1991, and Subulitermes Holmgren, 1910 in that all three are small, yellowish in coloration, and have cylindrical nasi. Of these, only the headcapsules of H. brevipilus, S. constricticeps, Constantino, 1991, and S. microsoma (Silvestri, 1903) lack long setae.
evidence.note: 鉴别要点（与 Ereymatermes、Subulitermes 的对比）

evidence.quote: Soldat [Tafel IV, Fig. 28]: Kopf wie bei einem Mirotermes, kurz walzenförmig mit einem deutlichen, abgerundeten Stirnvorsprung und unterhalb dieses mit einer recht grossen Fontanellenöffnung. Kopf behaart, aber um die Fontanelle reicher als sonst. Stirn unterhalb des Stirnvorsprunges nach vorn flach abfallend. Fontanellendrüse sehr gross, sich bis zum Nacken erstreckend. Oberlippe dreieckig (also nicht zweispaltig wie bei Mirotermes). Oberkiefer lang stäbchenartig, nur mit schwach eingebogener Spitze, symmetrisch. In der Mitte mit einem nach innen und etwas nach hinten gerichteten, scharfen Zahn. Basalteil der Kiefer sehr lang, so lang wie die übrigen Teile desselben. Grenze des Basalteiles von dem eigentlichen Kieferteil durch eine kleine Einknickung des Aussenrandes des Kiefers markiert. Molarteil der Kiefer absatzförmig, 4-eckig. Antennen 14-gliedrig. Pronotum sattelförmig. Hinterleib sehr dick, beinahe kugelförmig. Hinterleibsseiten wie aufgebläht als weite taschenförmige Flügel herausstehend. Beine kurz. Tibien mit zwei Apicaldornen. Cerci kurz, Styli fehlen.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/eremotermes/，兵蚁：头短柱状具圆额突、上颚长杆状带中齿、触角14节、前胸鞍形、胫节2端距；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldat: Von verhältnismässig grosser Statur. Körper mehr oder weniger dunkelfarbig. Kopf rektangular, flach gewölbt. Fontanelle wenig deutlich. Hinter den Augen mit hellen Augenflecken. Clypeus zweilappig. Oberlippe oval, etwas zugespitzt. Oberkiefer sehr lang, stark säbelformig gekrümmt, schmal, fast in der Mitte mit einem langen senkrecht zum Innenrand stehenden, schief abgestutzten Zahn.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/drepanotermes/，兵蚁：体较大、头长方形平凸、后唇基二叶、上颚长镰状带斜截齿；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Arbeiter: Von derselben Grösse wie der Soldat oder etwas grösser. Färbung dieselbe. Beine lang. Kopf gross, breit oval. Fontanelle sehr deutlich. Sagittalnaht sehr deutlich. Transversalnähte undeutlich. Ozellen(?) angedeutet. Hinter den Antennen mit einem hellen Augenfleck. Clypeus sehr gross, aufgetrieben, hell begrenzt. Oberlippe breiter als lang, hell. Antennen 18-gliedrig; 2. Glied so lang wie 3. und 4. zusammengenommen, 3. deutlich länger als 4., 5. etwas länger als 3. Pronotum viel schmaler als der Kopf. Vordertibien mit 3 Apicaldornen.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/drepanotermes/，工蚁：头大宽卵形、囟与矢状缝显著、后唇基大而隆起、触角18节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldat: Kopf rektangular, ziemlich flach gewölbt, mit flacher Stirn. Stirnwulst und Fontanelle fehlen. Oberhalb der Antennenwurzeln mit einer recht grossen, abgerundeten, tuberkelförmigen Verbreiterung der Antennenleisten. Oberlippe kurz, etwa so lang wie breit, zungenförmig aber mit etwas abgerundet hervortretenden Seitenecken (schwach 3-lappig). Oberkiefer (Fig. 85) symmetrisch. Basalteil sehr breit, nach vorn mit einem recht stark verlängerten Teil in den Mittteil des Oberkiefers übergehend. An der Übergangsstelle zwischen Basalteil und Mittteil mit einer Zahnandeutung. Oberkiefer vor der Mitte schwach knieförmig nach aussen gebogen. An der Umbiegungsstelle liegt der Mittzahn. Spitze eingebogen. Rechter Oberkiefer oben an der Spitze etwas konkaviert. Antennen 15-gliedrig. Pronotum sattelförmig.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/orthognathotermes/，兵蚁：头矩形平凸无额隆与囟、触角脊瘤状加宽、上颚对称带中齿、触角15节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldat: Kopf rektangular, länger als breit. Oberkiefer kurz, mit einem nach hinten gerichteten Zahn (Fig. 58). Clypeus einfach, nicht zweilappig. Fontanelle undeutlich. Antennen 13—14-gliedrig. Arbeiter: Clypeus gross. Antennen 13—14-gliedrig.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/synhamitermes/，兵蚁：头长方形、上颚短具后指齿、后唇基不二裂、触角13–14节；工蚁触角13–14节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Imago: Kopf beinahe kreisrund, nach vorn geradlinig verschmälert. Stirn recht stark gewölbt. Facettenaugen klein, stark vorstehend. Ozellen ziemlich klein, von den Augen um ihren Durchmesser entfernt, Innenrand etwas erhoben. Fontanelle deutlich, weit nach hinten gelegen, so dass das Transversalband in der Mitte recht lang ist. Basalteil des Clypeus ziemlich gewölbt, so lang wie seine halbe Breite oder etwas kürzer, nach hinten ziemlich stark bogenförmig begrenzt. Oberlippe in der Mitte kaum breiter als an der Basis, ohne Chitinquerband. Mandibeln mit Termes-Bewaffnung (Fig. 51). Basalteil wenig stark entwickelt. Antennen 15-gliedrig, 3. Glied viel kürzer als 2. und etwas kürzer als 4. (oder 14-gliedrig: 3. Glied so lang wie 2.).
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/eurytermes/，有翅成虫：头近圆形前收窄、复眼小而强突、囟很靠后、触角15节第3节远短于第2节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldat: Kopf dick, rektangular. Augen fehlen. Kopfnähte nicht sichtbar. Fontanelle kaum einmal angedeutet. Clypeus kurz. Oberlippe dreieckig, ziemlich kurz, ohne hyaline Spitze. Mandibeln ziemlich kurz, plump.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/eurytermes/，兵蚁：头粗长方形、无眼、头缝不可见、囟几不显、上唇三角无透明尖、上颚短壮；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Imago: Kopf (ziemlich) breit, oval, etwas länger als breit. Facettenaugen recht gross, flach gewölbt, nicht vorstehend. Ozellen in derselben Ebene wie die Stirn (Innenrand nicht erhoben), von den Augen um weniger als ihren Durchmesser entfernt. Fontanelle deutlich, ziemlich weit nach hinten gelegen. Basalteil des Clypeus viel kürzer als seine halbe Breite, hinten nur schwach konvex begrenzt, vorn gerade, beinahe flach. Oberlippe in der Mitte breiter als basal, ohne Chitinquerband. Mandibeln mit Termes-Bewaffnung (Fig. 49). Basalteil nicht besonders stark hervortretend. Antennen 15-gliedrig, 3. Glied kürzer als 2., aber so lang wie 4.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/prohamitermes/，有翅成虫：头宽卵形、眼大平凸不突出、单眼与额同高、囟靠后、唇基远短于半宽、触角15节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldat (Fig. 50): Kopf oval, nach vorn schwach verschmälert, flach gewölbt, nach vorn gegen die Oberlippe hin abgeplattet. Augen fehlen. Kopfnähte nicht sichtbar. Fontanelle sehr schwach angedeutet, etwa in der Mitte des Kopfes. Fontanellendrüse klein. Clypeus kurz, flach. Oberlippe beinahe dreieckig, ohne hyaline Spitze. Oberkiefer (Fig. 50) säbelformig gekrümmt, scharf gespitzt, mit grossem Basalteil, ziemlich kurzem Mittteil und länger Spitze, die basal etwas zahnförmig erweitert ist. Mittteil auf jeder Seite mit zwei kleinen Zähnen. Basalteil auf jeder Seite mit einem kleinen Molarhöcker, ziemlich breit. Antennen 14-gliedrig. 3. Glied unbedeutend länger als 2.; 2. etwas länger als 4. Submentum in der Mitte stark höckerförmig (oder blasenförmig) aufgetrieben.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/prohamitermes/，兵蚁：上唇近三角无透明尖、上颚中部每侧2小齿、触角14节、亚颏中部驼峰状、胫距3:2:2；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Clypeus beinahe immer wenigstens so lang wie seine halbe Breite (Ausnahme A. Iheringi), gewöhnlich stark gewölbt. Transversalband in der Mitte länger als auf den Seiten. Oberkiefer (Fig. 46) mit einem grossen Spitzenzahn, etwas verlängert. Siehe die Figur! Antennen immer 15-gliedrig; 3. Glied gewöhnlich viel kürzer als die anliegenden. Gehirn gross (Fig. 47). Pronotum wie bei Eutermes. Mesound Metanotum hinten mehr oder weniger tief ausgeschnitten. Flügel dunkel, behaart und bestachelt. Rippen wie bei Eutermes. Tibien mit zwei Apicaldornen. Hinterleib langgestreckt; Seiten beim ♀ mit Exudattrichomen.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/anoplotermes/，有翅成虫：上颚1大端齿、触角恒15节、翅暗色被毛具刺、胫节2端距；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: halbe Breite oder sogar länger. Antennen immer 14-gliedrig; 3. Glied meistens kürzer als die anliegenden. Kopf meistens hell gefärbt, mit wenig deutlicher Fontanelle.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/anoplotermes/，工蚁：后唇基约与半宽等长或更长、触角恒14节、头浅色囟不显（兵蚁完全缺失见L5168）；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Imago: Nur die Flügel sind vorhanden, aber diese sind sehr charakteristisch und für die Ableitung der Mirotermes-Reihe so bedeutungsvoll, dass sie wohl eine Beschreibung verdienen. Vorderflügel. Das Feld zwischen dem Costalrande und dem Radius sector ist basal ungewöhnlich breit. In diesem Felde gibt es einen ungewöhnlich stark entwickelten Radius, der sogar 1—2 vordere Zweige gegen den Costalrand aussendet. Radius sector basal bisweilen mit einer kurzen vorderen Rippe und mit hinteren Apicalzweigen. Mediana frei aus der Schuppe mit 6—8 Zweigen. Cubitus mit c:a 14 dicht gestellten Rippen, welche den Hinterrand des Flügels erreichen. Von diesen sind die 8—9 inneren etwas verdeckt. Feld zwischen Radius sector und Mediana deutlich netzadrig. Hinterflügel. Radius kürzer als im Vorderflügel. Mediana in dem inneren Drittel mit vorderen kräftigeren akzessorischen Rippen. Mediana mit 4—5 Zweigen zur Spitze oder zum Hinterrande des Flügels. Cubitus mit c:a 16 hinteren Zweigen. Übrigens wie im Vorderflügel. Flügel besonders basal dunkel, fein punktiert. Länge der Vorderflügel 12,5 mm.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/apicotermes/，有翅成虫（仅翅）：径脉发达带1–2前支、中脉6–8支、肘脉约14条、前翅长12.5mm；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldat [Tafel IV, Fig. 2]: Kopf langgestreckt, viereckig etwa ein halbmal länger als breit. nach vorn sehr wenig verschmälert, relativ flach. Stirn flach und etwas dreieckig eingedrückt. Fontanelle klein, deutlich, ohne behaarte Umgebung. Clypeobasale von der Stirn nicht deutlich begrenzt. Clypeoapicale ziemlich klein. Oberlippe ziemlich breit zungenförmig mit einer kurzen, rundlichen, weissen, behaarten Spitze. Oberkiefer (Fig. 72) kurz und sehr kräftig. Spitze recht stark eingebogen. Spitzenund Mittteile des linken Kiefers mit 3 Zahnhöckern, von denen der äussere am grössten ist und etwa in der Mitte des Apicalteils der Mandibeln liegt. Basalteil gross mit einem kräftigen Basalhöcker. Rechter Kiefer mit zwei schwachen Zahnhöckerchen im Mittteil, mit einer kurzen, kleinen Molarecke und hinter dieser im Basalteil mit einem kleinen nach vorn gerichteten Rudimentärzahn. Antennen 14-gliedrig; 3. Glied etwa halb so lang wie 2.; 4. etwas kürzer als 2.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/apicotermes/，兵蚁：头长约宽1.5倍、囟小无毛环、上唇舌形白端、上颚短壮3齿瘤、触角14节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Imago: Kopf breit eiformig. Augen oft etwas bis stark vorstehend. Fontanelle deutlich etwas erhoben. Fontanellenplatte vorhanden. Ozellen von den Augen mehr oder weniger entfernt, ziemlich gross, Innenrand etwas erhoben, so dass die Ozellen etwas nach seitwärts blicken. Clypeus beinahe so lang wie seine halbe Breite. Basalteil aufgetrieben, hinten konvex, vorn gerade, Spitzenteil gewöhnlich relativ klein. Oberlippe länger als breit, mit Chitinquerband. Mandibeln mit Termes-Bewaffnung. Antennen 19-gliedrig; 3. Glied länger als 2.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/termes/，有翅成虫：头宽卵形、眼常突出、唇基约半宽、触角19节第3长于第2；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldat: 2 Grössen. Kopf nach vorn mehr oder weniger verschmälert, bisweilen beinahe parallelseitig, Fontanelle mit Fontanellendrüsen immer vorhanden. Augen immer als helle Flecke angedeutet. Stirn flach, nach hinten von zwei flachen Rinnen gegen die Fontanelle begrenzt. Clypeobasale ziemlich schmal, rektangular, nach hinten wenig scharf begrenzt. Spitzenteil sehr kurz, hyalin. Oberlippe an oder vor der Mitte am breitesten, mit einem wohlentwickelten, hyalinen Spitzenteil. Oberkiefer von etwas wechselnder Länge, säbelformig gebogen; der linke basal 3-mal gekerbt und mit deutlichem Basalzahn, der rechte, mit Ausnahme des Basalzahnes, unbezahnt. Antennen 17-gliedrig, 3. Glied länger als 2. Submentum schmal, rektangular, in der Mitte am schmalsten.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/termes/，兵蚁：头向前收窄、上颚镰刀状、左上颚基部3处缺刻、触角17节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Imago: Kopf breit, beinahe kreisförmig. Facettenaugen mittelgross, vorstehend. Ozellen etwas seitwärts schauend, beinahe kreisrund, von den Augen um ihren Durchmesser entfernt. Fontanelle vorhanden. Basalteil des Clypeus sogar länger als seine halbe Breite, relativ schmal; hinten stark konvex, vorn gerade, ziemlich stark aufgetrieben, viel heller als die Stirn. Spitzteil hyalin. Oberlippe länger als breit, mit Chitinquerband. Mandibeln mit Termes-Bewaffnung. 1. Zahn etwas grösser als 2. Antennen 20—23-gliedrig (♂ mit 1—2 Gliedern mehr als ♀). Pronotum vorn jederseits der Mittellinie mit zwei kleinen tuberkelförmigen Erhebungen. Mesonotum hinten etwas breiter ausgeschnitten als Metanotum. Flügel hyalin, basal und vorn mit gebräunten Rippen. Membran schwach retikuliert. Radius rudimentär, kommt nicht ausserhalb der Flügelschuppe. Mediana der Vorderflügel frei von der Schuppe, der Hinterflügel von der Basis des Radius sector, schwach, mit Ast zu dem Radius sector und zu der Spitze des Flügels. Cubitus mit verdickten inneren Rippen, sonst wie die Mediana.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/acanthotermes/，有翅成虫：头宽近圆、眼中等突出、唇基基部至少半宽、触角20–23节、前胸背板两瘤突；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldat I. Gross. Kopf nach vorn mehr oder weniger verschmälert, parallelseitig, eiförmig—herzförmig, hinten gerade bis stark konkav. Fontanelle deutlich, von einer behaarten kreisrunden Partie umgeben. Vor der Fontanelle mit einer dornartigen Erhebung. Mandibelkondylen kräftig. Clypeobasale sehr kurz; Clypeoapicale ziemlich gross, hyalin. Oberlippe ziemlich breit, mit dreilappiger, hyaliner Spitze. Oberkiefer ziemlich kurz, kräftig, mehr oder weniger stark gebogen, mit einem mehr oder weniger scharfen, grossen Basalzahn. Der linke ausserdem mit 3 bis mehreren ziemlich kleinen, höckerförmigen Zähnen und mit einer basal oft gekerbten und zahnartig hervorspringenden Spitze. Rechter Oberkiefer im übrigen unbewaffnet (Fig. 1). Antennen 17—20-gliedrig.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/acanthotermes/，兵蚁大兵：头前收窄侧平行、囟周毛环与刺状隆起、左上颚3至多枚瘤齿、触角17–20节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Imago: Kopf breit eiformig. Fontanelle gross, kreisrund—oval. Facettenaugen relativ klein, stark vorstehend. Ozellen von den Augen weit entfernt. Basalteil des Clypeus ungefähr so lang wie seine halbe Breite, mehr oder weniger stark aufgetrieben. Spitzenteil hyalin. Oberlippe breiter als lang, ohne Querband. Mandibeln mit Termes-Bewaffnung. Antennen 20—21-gliedrig, ziemlich lang.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/syntermes/，有翅成虫：头宽卵形、囟大、眼相对小强突、单眼远离、上唇宽大于长无横带、触角20–21节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Kopf gross, ziemlich breit, nach vorn verschmälert, flach gewölbt. Fontanelle mit Fontanellendrüse vorhanden, an der Spitze eines sehr kurzen Frontaltubus mündend. Stirn eingedrückt. Clypeus sehr kurz. Oberlippe kurz und breit, mit dreilappiger Spitze. Von den Lappen ist der mittlere gewöhnlich hyalin. Oberkiefer kräftig, ziemlich stark gebogen (Fig. 4). Spitze des linken Oberkiefers basal etwas erweitert und dann verengt. Auf der Spitze folgen ein oft sehr kräftiger Zahn und innerhalb dieses 2 kleinere Zähne und der gewöhnlich kräftige Basalzahn. Rechter Oberkiefer mit einem etwas hockerigen Basalzahne. Antennen mit langgestreckten Gliedern, lang, 19—20-gliedrig.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/syntermes/，兵蚁单型：头大前收窄、额腺孔短额管端、上唇三裂、上颚齿序、触角19–20节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Imago: Von der Imago des Cornitermes nur wenig verschieden. Der Kopf ist jedoch durchschnittlich kleiner, wie auch die Statur etwas kleiner ist. Augen von variabler Grösse. Ozellen von abwechselnder Grösse und Lage. Fontanelle deutlich, klein bis sehr gross. Stirn etwas eingedrückt.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/armitermes/，有翅成虫：与Cornitermes仅微异、头平均较小、眼大小多变、唇基基部至少半宽；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Kopf birnförmig in einen kürzeren und längeren, kegelförmigen Frontaltubus ausgezogen. Fontanelle gross, in der Spitze des Frontaltubus gelegen. Fontanellendrüse sehr gross. Transversalband (und Stirn) sehr klein, unterhalb der Nase versteckt. Clypeus klein, von dem Transversalband kaum begrenzt. Oberlippe kurz und relativ breit. Oberkiefer oft sehr stark gekrümmt. Basalteil der linken Seite gross bis sehr gross, ofters mit einer scharfen Molarecke, oder mit zwei scharfen Zähnen vor der Molarecke. Mittteil in verschiedener Weise bezahnt: 1. Mit zwei von einander wohl getrennten Zähnen, von denen der innere sehr schwach ist. Basalteil nicht plötzlich erweitert; Molarecke nicht scharf; 2. Mittteil mit zwei deutlichen, zusammengetretenen Zähnen, von denen der erste grösser ist; Basalteil plötzlich erweitert; Molarecke zugespitzt; 3. Die zwei Mittzähne zu einem verschmolzen. Dieser besitzt eine schief abgeschnittene Spitze. Basalteil stark erweitert; Molarecke scharf zugespitzt. 4. Mittzahn nach hinten gerichtet. Basalteil äusserst stark entwickelt, mit zwei scharfen Zähnen vor der Molarecke.

evidence.quote: SOLDIER (FIG. 1): Head with numerous short hairs and bristles scattered over the front, top, sides, and postmentum in contrast to the very few bristles on the head and the nearly bare postmenta of Hoplognathotermes subterraneus (fig. 3) and Acutidentitermes osborni (fig. 5). Three or four bristles are seen in the profile of the flatly convex apical portion of the front coxa, and a few bristles and hairs are seen in the profile of the sharply convex basal portion. Also a number of very short hairs are seen on the rounded longitudinal ridge as one turns the coxa from side to side. The general shape of the head (fig. 1A) is not generically different from that in Hoplognathotermes (fig. 3A), and both genera have a relatively flat front without conspicuous ridges or protuberances. The fontanelle is small and rather inconspicuous as in Hoplognathotermes and Acutidentitermes.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/firmitermes/，兵蚁：头面遍布短毛与刚毛、头形无属级差异、后颏与基节毛被较Hoplognathotermes丰富；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Imago: The following generic characters depend on the highly tentative assignment of “Eutermes” tripolitanus to Firmitermes. The apical tooth of both mandibles (fig. 2) is smaller, more slender, and closer to the first marginal tooth than that of the worker mandibles of Hoplognathotermes (fig. 4) or Acutidentitermes (fig. 6). The angle between the apical and first marginal teeth of the left mandible is sharper in ?Firmitermes. The first plus second marginal tooth of the left mandible is about the same actual length in ?Firmitermes and Acutidentitermes, but the notch in front of the third marginal tooth is not quite so sharp, and the apical edge of the third marginal tooth is longer in ?Firmitermes, while it is definitely convex and shorter in Acutidentitermes. The third marginal tooth is proportionately much larger than in any known genus of primitive Termitinae or Amitermitinae.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/firmitermes/，有翅成虫（?F. tripolitanus）：端齿更小更细、左颚第3缘齿比例远大于已知原始属；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: short hairs on the posterior tergites and sternites. Head large, with straight parallel sides. Profile of the head flat or slightly concave in the region of the frontal gland. Postmentum large, with a moderate constriction; profile somewhat convex. Antenna with 15 articles. Postclypeus distinct and slightly arched. Labrum with rounded lateral margins, straight parallel sides behind the lateral angles, and tip rounded and blunt. Each mandible has a conspicuous, large, forward-pointing marginal tooth in front of the middle. Tooth of left mandible with a long, basal, cutting edge in contrast to that of Firmitermes.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/hoplognathotermes/，兵蚁：头大两侧直平行、额腺区剖面平或微凹、后颏中度缢缩、触角15节、上颚各1枚中点前的前指大缘齿、左颚长基切缘；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: with a long, basal, cutting edge in contrast to that of Firmitermes. Anterior lobe of pronotum fairly large, with a shallow, rather indistinct indentation in the middle of the front margin. Legs long compared to those of Duplidentitermes. Front coxa long compared to those of Duplidentitermes, simple, with a blunt, unmodified, longitudinal ridge, fairly straight or flatly convex in profile, and extending from the apex to about one-third to one-half of the length of the coxa; portion between ridge and inner margin convex. Femora slender, with middle portions of nearly equal thickness. Tibial spurs 3:2:2, without any dark outer spines on the middle tibia.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/hoplognathotermes/，兵蚁：前胸背板前叶较大前缘中凹浅、足与前足基节较Duplidentitermes长、基节纵锁钝未特化、腿节细、端距3:2:2中胫无深色外刺；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: SOLDIER (Fig. 5): The genus resembles Hoplognathotermes (fig. 3) in the small number of rather short bristles on the head and none near the fontanelle. The postmentum lacks hairs or bristles completely. The first four tergites have fairly long bristles, with few or no hairs, but additional short hairs occur on the posterior tergites and sternites. The head (fig. 5A) is massive, the sides of the head are slightly convex and fairly parallel, and the fontanelle is rather small. The postmentum (fig. 5B) is more bulbous than that of Hoplognathotermes and has overlapping lateral margins that obscure the lateral sutures except near the posterior margin when viewed from below.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/acutidentitermes/，兵蚁：头硕大两侧微凸近平行、囟较小、后颏更膨大、后唇基缝远不明显；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote:
Little is known of the ecology and range of the genus and species.
The single locality is in the Ituri rain forest near the Epulu River in
the Belgian Congo. The single soldier, together with its associated
workers, is a sample of a subterranean colony. All the known related
genera are subterranean, without surface indications of their nests.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/acutidentitermes/，新属记述：仅Ituri雨林Epulu河一地、1头兵蚁连同同巢工蚁取自地下巢

evidence.quote: SOLDIER (FIGS. 7, 8): There seems little doubt that Hoplognathotermes (fig. 3), Duplidentitermes, and Allognathotermes (Emerson, 1956b, p. 24, fig. 7) are related genera. The soldiers are similar in the lack of a clump of hairs near the frontal gland opening and in the scattered bristles at the front end of the large labrum (not bunched as in Apicotermes). Several (nine to 11) conspicuous bristles are in a row along the sharp ridge of the front coxa (fig. 7C) and extend in a curve towards the inner edge and recurve towards the apex to enclose a somewhat oval, flat area inside the apical half of the coxa. Front tibia with several inner spines not showing great specialization. The middle tibia lacks outer contrasting spines.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/duplidentitermes/，兵蚁：与Hoplognathotermes、Allognathotermes近缘、前足基节锐脊上9–11根成列刚毛、中胫无外侧刺；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: fontanelle of the imago is white, triangular, and only slightly smaller than the ocellus. Imago mandibles (Ahmad, 1950, pp. 69, 83, fig. 14, “Hoplognathotermes”) similar in general to the worker mandibles of D. jurioni (fig. 9). The apical tooth is proportionately larger than in Hoplognathotermes (fig. 4). The distance from the apical tip to the tip of the first marginal tooth is greater than the distance from the tip of the first marginal tooth to the tip of the third marginal tooth of the left mandible. The cutting edge of the first plus second marginal tooth of the left mandible undulates as in figure 9. The second marginal tooth of the right mandible is reduced to a small hump as in Allognathotermes. The hind margins of the mesonotum and metanotum are deeply indented with points sharper than right angles. The front coxa has a sharp longitudinal ridge which is flatly convex in profile, with the peak of the hump towards the basal end and not in the middle of the ridge. Tibial spurs 3:2:2; outer spur of front tibia short and markedly reduced. Both wings with a short Sc immediately apical to the basal suture and joining the costal margin close to the suture.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/duplidentitermes/，有翅成虫：囟白色三角、端齿比例较大、右颚第2缘齿退化为小丘、端距3:2:2、前翅Sc短；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: 8). Allognathotermes (Emerson, 1956b, p. 24, fig. 7) has less prominent teeth than Hoplognathotermes or Duplidentitermes, but it has two more separated teeth that seem to be homologous with the doublepointed tooth of Duplidentitermes in the left mandible.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/allognathotermes/，兵蚁：齿较Hoplognathotermes、Duplidentitermes不显著、另有2枚分离较开之齿与双尖齿同源；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: pointed tooth of Duplidentitermes in the left mandible. Front coxa (fig. 7C) with a conspicuous, sharp, longitudinal ridge, with a flat, evenly convex profile extending from the apex for about half of the length of the coxa. The front coxal ridge is more arched and prominent than in Hoplognathotermes, but is very similar to that of Allognathotermes, differing only in being a little more distinct owing to a slight curved extension towards the inner surface. Front femur short and robust in Duplidentitermes and Allognathotermes and markedly different from the long and slender front femur of Firmitermes, Hoplognathotermes, and Acutidentitermes. Front femur with parallel sides and equal thickness in the middle portion. Front tibia somewhat swollen. Tibial spurs 3:2:2, with the outer spur of the front tibia proportionately short as in Hoplognathotermes.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/allognathotermes/，前足基节脊与Duplidentitermes相似、前足腿节短粗、端距3:2:2；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

tibia with no modified outer spines. Head thick and massive, with

evidence.quote: mandibles (figs. 10A, 11B) are short and massive, with slightly hooked apical points, each mandible with a small but more or less distinct tooth somewhat anterior to the middle of the total length, and each mandible also with a small but distinct tooth at the front of a ventrally protruding thick basal portion not continuous with the cutting edge extending from the apex to the rear of the median tooth, but the tooth is on a protruding ventral portion that forms a somewhat separate, blunt, cutting edge in front of the small molar plate. The pronotum (fig. 10B) is somewhat flared out at the sides and rear; the anterior margin is wide and is slightly and evenly convex, without any distinct emargination or indentation; side margins rounded and hind margin indented and depressed in the middle. The sharp longitudinal ridge of the front coxa has a very conspicuous, long, nipple-like projection with a rounded tip (fig. 10C), more robust and less elongated than in Coxotermes, and with a more concave surface at the base of the projection. Front femur is equally thick in the middle portion as in Coxotermes. The tibial spurs are 2:2:2.

evidence.quote: Description Worker: Medium-sized (see Table 3). Head pale yellow, rounded to slightly ovoid, fully covered by about 60 setae. Fontanelle indistinct. Mandibles as in Figure 2D. Fore tibia strongly inﬂated, about three times as long as wide.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁中型、头淡黄被约 60 根刚毛、前胫节强烈膨大约 3 倍于宽。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve inserted into an extension of the paunch, consisting of six elongated pads, each composed of about 100 scales and endowed posteriorly with about 15 weakly sclerotized spines.
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣着生于 paunch 延伸部，6 个细长垫、每垫约 100 枚鳞片、后缘约 15 根弱硬化刺。

evidence.quote: Amplucrutermes is clearly distinct from all other described South American soldierless termite genera. It can be recognized by its enlarged fore tibia, which are similar to Tetimatermes but less concave and lacking proximal glands. The enteric valves of Amplucrutermes, composed of about 100 scales and 15 weakly sclerotized apical spines, are also diagnostic (Fig. 2C).
evidence.note: 支撑：与所有已知南美无兵蚁白蚁属区分；前胫节似 Tetimatermes 但凹陷较浅、近端无腺体；肠瓣约 100 鳞片 + 15 根弱硬化端刺。

evidence.quote: Hydrecotermes is morphologically closest to Grigiotermes and Patawatermes but can easily be distinguished from these two genera by its smaller workers devoid of enteric valve armatures. Its workers differ from other Neotropical soldierless termites by their enlarged P1 and overall squat abdomen, and by their oval enteric valve cushions without armature.
evidence.note: 支撑：最接近 Grigiotermes 与 Patawatermes，工蚁更小且肠瓣无硬化 armature；P1 膨大、腹部粗短、肠瓣垫卵形无刺。

evidence.quote: Medium-sized, with head width between 0.6 and 0.8 mm. Abdomen with slightly enlarged digestive tract. Head pale yellow, rounded, covered by 50 to 200 bristles and devoid of tiny ones.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁中型、头宽 0.6–0.8 mm、腹部消化道略膨大、头淡黄圆形被 50–200 根刚毛而无微毛。

evidence.quote: Sclerotized body dark brown, covered by thousands of tiny setae. Head covered by a few long bristles. Eyes and ocelli large. Fontanelle fairly large, situated at the posterior level of eyes and appearing as a spot devoid of setae.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫体部深褐密被微毛、头仅数根长刚毛、复眼与单眼大、fontanelle 大而位于复眼后缘水平且无毛。

evidence.quote: Worker: Large, head width over 0.9 mm. Abdomen with subconical distal half and elongated digestive tract.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁体型大（头宽 > 0.9 mm）、腹末半亚圆锥形、消化道延长。

evidence.quote: Head pale yellow, rounded, fully covered with various numbers of tiny setae and between 50 and 100 long bristles. Fontanelle small, almost indistinct. Fore tibia long and slender.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头淡黄、圆形，密被小毛与 50–100 根长刚毛；囟小几不可见；前胫节细长。

evidence.quote: Imago: Sclerotized body parts dark brown, covered by thousands of tiny setae. Head covered by about 100 scattered long bristles. Eyes and ocelli large.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫硬化部深褐、密被小毛；头具约 100 根散生长刚毛；复眼与单眼大。

evidence.quote: Grigiotermes is distinguishable from other genera of South American soldierless termites by its workers with widened P 1 in which the food bolus has a visible serpentine path.
evidence.note: 支撑：以工蚁 P1 极宽、食物团呈可见蛇形路径区别于南美其他无兵蚁属。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve inserted into a short extension of the paunch, with welldeveloped armature composed of six spiny plates.
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣位于胃（paunch）的短延伸部内，武装为 6 块具刺骨板。

evidence.quote: Mesenteric junction forming a small ball overlapping the proctodeum, slightly elongated to form a short, distinct mixed segment.
evidence.note: 支撑：中肠接点成小球状叠于后肠之上，略延长形成短而明显的混合段。

evidence.quote: Fontanelle fairly small to medium size, situated at the level of eyes. Pronotum elongated, covered by dozens of long bristles.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫囟小至中等、位于复眼水平；前胸背板延长。

evidence.quote: Worker: Head covered by about 100 long bristles. Cushions of enteric valve with sclerotized armature composed of six tufts that are each composed of about 20 medium-sized spines.
evidence.note: 支撑 Patawatermes turricola 的形态描述

evidence.quote: Patawatermes turricola differs from P. nigripunctatus by its enteric valve armature with fewer, stouter spines with multidirectional orientation.
evidence.note: 支撑 Patawatermes turricola 的形态描述

evidence.quote: distal margin of the enteric valve (P2) not everted into the paunch (P3) but bending towards the ileum (P1), that is, directed against the flow of food
evidence.note: 属级鉴别核心：肠瓣远端逆流弯折

evidence.quote: Reduced ridges on molar areas are found in Araujotermes , Atlantitermes , Coatitermes , Convexitermes , Ereymatermes , Paraconvexitermes , and Subulitermes , but none of these genera have lost the marginal teeth.

sources.title: Chasitermes pax, a new genus and species of soldierless termite (Termitidae, Apicotermitinae) from the island of Trinidad

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. The combination of unsclerotized rectangular EVA cushions, a tubular extension of EVS, and a prominent spherical mesenteric tongue make C. pax unique among all Apicotermitinae genera.
evidence.note: 支撑：不硬化长方形 EVA 垫、EVS 管状延伸、球形 mesenteric tongue 三特征组合使其区别于全部 Apicotermitinae 属。

evidence.quote: Description. Imago unknown. Worker. (Figs 1–4). Monomorphic. Head capsule and antennae light yellowish.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫未知、单型、头壳与触角淡黄。

evidence.quote: Cuticle of EVA without sclerotization (Fig. 4A, B) forming six rectangular cushions with about 100 scales each (Fig. 4A).
evidence.note: 支撑：EVA 角质层不硬化，形成 6 个长方形垫，每垫约 100 枚鳞片。

evidence.quote: Description. Imago unknown. Worker. (Figs 1-4). Monomorphic. Head capsule and antennae light yellowish. Head covered with ca 50 longer (0.1 mm) setae and a few shorter ones (Fig. 1). In lateral view, dorsal surface of the head capsule slightly convex; postclypeus is moderately inflated. Antennae with 14 articles (formula 2>3~4<5). Pronotum with about 20 long setae concentrated mainly at the borders and a few shorter ones. Mandibles with apical teeth very prominent; left mandible with M1 triangulate, shorter than apical; premolar process longer than M3 (Fig. 2A). Apical tooth of right mandible as long as that of left but narrower; M1 as long as M2. Fore tibia moderately inflated (Fig. 2C) with about a dozen thick posterior setae concentrated at the distal half; lateral and anterior surfaces with thinner long and shorter setae.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁外形与触角节数

sources.notes: JATS 全文（_tmp/lit/fulltext/07-noentry-a/chasitermes.xml）与出版社 PDF（_tmp/lit/pdfs/07-noentry-a/chasitermes.pdf）互校；引文取自 JATS（已去行内标签），页数据 PDF 印刷页码。

sources.title: Echinotermes biriba, a new genus and species of soldierless termite from the Colombian and Peruvian Amazon (Termitidae, Apicotermitinae)

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. The crop of E. biriba is unusually large and the enteric valve armature, consisting of six spherical pectinate pads, is unique among all apicotermitine genera.
evidence.note: 支撑：嗉囊异常大、肠瓣为 6 个球形栉状垫，在 Apicotermitinae 中独有。

evidence.quote: Monomorphic. Head capsule and antennae a light yellowish colour; pronotum pale yellow; legs hyaline.
evidence.note: 支撑：单型、头与触角淡黄、前胸背板淡黄、足透明。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve seating trilobed, with smaller lobe not visible in intact gut. Enteric valve with six cushions, terminating at the opening to the P3 as spiny spheroids (Fig. 2).
evidence.note: 支撑：EVS 三叶且较小一叶在完整肠道中不可见；肠瓣 6 垫，末端呈带刺球状。

sources.notes: JATS 全文（_tmp/lit/fulltext/07-noentry-a/echinotermes.xml）与出版社 PDF 互校；属级 Diagnosis 位于 p. 24。

sources.title: Compositermes vindai (Isoptera: Termitidae: Apicotermitinae), a new genus and species of soldierless termite from the Neotropics

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. The enteric valve cushions, much enlarged and tubular enteric valve seating, and the sclerotized pectinate paddles at the S/P3 junction are unique among all termite workers.
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣垫增大、EVS 长管状、S/P3 交界处硬化栉状小铲，为全体白蚁工蚁中所仅见。

evidence.quote: P2 formed by six slightly incongruent, egg-shaped cushions. Intersection of S and P3 embellished with 15–20 small pectinate paddles visible externally in situ under microscope when abdominal integument removed.
evidence.note: 支撑：P2 由 6 个略不整齐的卵形垫组成；S/P3 交界处 15–20 枚小栉状铲，剥去体壁后自外部可见。

evidence.quote: Imago unknown. Worker (Figs. 3–6). Monomorphic. Fore tibia moderately inflated (ratio length/width 3.98).
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫未知；单型；前胫节中度膨大，长宽比 3.98。

evidence.quote: Compositermes vindai is named in honor of Boudanath (Vinda) Maharajh (1950-2009) who first joined our termite diversity survey team in 1996 at his homeland of Trinidad and Tobago
evidence.note: 支撑：vindai 纪念特立尼达采集助手 Boudanath Vinda Maharajh

sources.notes: PDF 自 mapress.com 公开下载（bz2 无）；Zootaxa 未在 PDF 内标注开放许可，故 license 记 unknown。属级描述跨 pp. 381–383。

sources.title: Gastrotermes spinatus gen. n. sp. n., an African soil-feeding termite described from the worker caste (Isoptera, Termitidae, Apicotermitidae)

evidence.quote: Description. Imago. Unknown. Soldier. Unknown, but may exist. Worker. Head, pronotum, and abdomen covered with hundreds of long or very long hairs
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫未知、兵蚁未知但可能存在；工蚁头、前胸背板与腹部密被数百根长至很长的毛。

evidence.quote: An absence of a mixed segment and the presence of both a very short P1 and a voluminous trilobite enteric valve seating places Gastrotermes in the Apicotermes group (sensu Noirot 2001).
evidence.note: 支撑：无 mixed segment、P1 很短、EVS 大而三叶，归入 Apicotermes 群。

evidence.quote: Also, genera within the Labidotermes subgroup lack P3a spines (as in L. celisi Deligne and Pasteels, Fig. 4C) while in Gastrotermes, the EVS is lined with small erect spines and the opening of the P3a is lined with many robust spines.
evidence.locator: p. 291, Diagnosis（与 Labidotermes 亚群对比）
evidence.note: 支撑：该亚群其他属 P3a 无刺，而本属 EVS 内壁具小直立刺、P3a 开口列粗壮刺。

sources.notes: PDF 自 mapress.com 公开下载；许可未标注。属级描述与 Diagnosis 同在 p. 291。

sources.title: Ebogotermes raphaeli, new genus and new species, an African soldierless termite described from the worker caste (Isoptera, Termitidae, Apicotermitinae)

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. Ebogotermes is the largest (Figs. 1, 2) of the soldierless apicotermitine workers in equatorial Africa.
evidence.note: 支撑：为赤道非洲无兵蚁 apicotermitine 工蚁中体型最大者。

evidence.quote: The circular mesenteron, well-developed mixed segment, moderately long P1, P3/P4 isthmus, and long tubular P4 place Ebogotermes in the Anoplotermes-group (Noirot, 2001).
evidence.note: 支撑：中肠成环、mixed segment 发达、P1 中等长、P3/P4 缢部、P4 长管状，归入 Anoplotermes 群。

evidence.quote: Worker. Head, thorax, abdomen, and legs covered with setae of varying lengths. Antennae with 14 articles. Postclypeus moderately inflated. Fore tibia slightly inflated. Tibial spurs 3, 2, 2.
evidence.note: 支撑：全身被长短不一刚毛、触角 14 节、后唇基中度膨大、前胫节轻微膨大、胫节距 3:2:2。

evidence.quote: Named for Raphael Awoumou Onana, the chief of Ebogo village, a resilient guide, and expert on Cameroonian termites.
evidence.note: 支撑：raphaeli 纪念 Raphael Awoumou Onana

sources.notes: PDF 自 mapress.com 公开下载；许可未标注。属级描述在 p. 279。

evidence.quote: Head very flat, with sides converging toward front; posterior margin three-lobed, middle lobe not so prominent; fontanelle small and circular; and frontal gland absent.

evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/biratermes/，仅 Biratermes／Mapinguaritermes／Ibitermes 三属工蚁垫具显著刺，为 Syntermitinae 其余成员所无

evidence.quote: Soldier. Head elongate, rectangular or sub-rectangular, narrowing slightly towards front with lateral and posterior margins slightly convex and posterolateral angles broadly rounded as in Bandeiratermes silvestrii (Fig. 13a) or with sides parallel from dorsal view (Bandeiratermes tellustris, Fig. 16a); head thickest at base of conical nasus, which extends forward almost as far as the extended mandibles; in profile dorsal surface of nasus convex near the base, somewhat humped, and somewhat upwards. Mandibles robust, curved inward, without teeth (in Ban. tellustris, Fig. 16a) or with small tooth on medial surface about one-third of distance from base to tip, tip of tooth rounded (in Ban. silvestrii, Fig. 13a); antenna with 14 articles;
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/bandeiratermes/，兵蚁头延长、长方形或近长方形、侧缘与后缘微凸、后侧角宽圆；触角 14 节

evidence.quote: Worker. Head capsule rounded. Postclypeus moderately inflated or more inflated. Antenna with 14 articles. Mandibles (Fig. 15f), [Constantino (1990) figs 9–10] with apical tooth (A) larger than marginal, acute angle or right between A and second marginal; LM: M1+2 with first very conspicuous or not as so. RM: second marginal tooth smaller than first, angle between them slightly more opened than a right angle. Molar regions without ridges.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/bandeiratermes/，工蚁头圆、后唇基中等至更膨大、触角 14 节；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Enteric valve (P2) composed of three nearly equal conical ridges, covered with curved spines (Fig. 14b), [Constantino (1990) fig. 12]. Dorsal torsion well developed. Third proctodeal segment joined P4 by an isthmus is inserted subapically (Figs 15a, 17a).
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/bandeiratermes/，P2 由三条近等锥形脊组成、覆弯刺；P3-P4 以峡部相连、峡部近端插入；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldier (Figs 5, 10). Head sub-rectangular, with lateral and posterior margins of varying convexity, rounded posterolateral angles; moderate-sized conical nasus, projecting forward to tooth region of extended mandible from above or shorter, reaching the anteclypeus;
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/vaninitermes/，兵蚁头近长方形、中等锥形鼻伸至前伸上颚齿区

evidence.quote: Worker. Head capsule rounded. Postclypeus short and inflated. Antennae with 13 or 14 articles. Mandibles (Fig. 7g), [Constantino (1991) fig. 38, Constantino (1992) fig. 3] with large apical teeth, with concave anterior margins, molar regions without ridges; left mandible (LM): sinuous anterior margin of M1+2; right mandible (RM): first marginal larger than second marginal, their contiguous margins forming an obtuse angle or right angle. Anterior margin of pronotum rounded. Head covered by scattered bristles and hairs. Long bristles on pronotal margins and hairs on surface. Meso and metanotum with long bristles on posterior margin and some hairs on surface. Many hairs and short bristles backward orientated on tergites and sternites, the last with a row of long bristles forward orientated. Yellowish white head, antennae lighter.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/vaninitermes/，工蚁头圆、后唇基短而膨大、触角 13 或 14 节

evidence.quote: Enteric valve (P2) composed of three nearly equal ridges covered with thin curved spines (Figs 6b, 11b). Dorsal torsion well-developed. P3 joined to P4 by an isthmus is inserted subapically (Figs 7a, 12a).
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/vaninitermes/，P2 三条近等脊覆细弯刺；P3-P4 以峡部相连、峡部近端插入

evidence.quote: Soldiers of Cahuallitermes Constantino have a rounded head, a well-developed labrum tip, and a postmentum with convex lateral margins (sinusoidal in Biratermes).
evidence.locator: Plazi treatment 03BB783D-FFB3-5729-FF38-92CB7F7000A8, Comparison with other genera of Syntermitinae
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/cahuallitermes/，兵蚁头圆、上唇端发达、后颏侧缘凸（与 Biratermes 的波状相对）

evidence.quote: In the genera Cyrilliotermes Fontes and Curvitermes Holmgren the soldiers have peculiar mandibles, with a molar plate, molar prominence, and marginal teeth quite similar to the mandibles of their corresponding workers. In addition, the apical tooth is hook-shaped in Curvitermes, reduced in Cyrilliotermes;
evidence.locator: Plazi treatment 03BB783D-FFB3-5729-FF38-92CB7F7000A8, Comparison with other genera of Syntermitinae
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/curvitermes/，兵蚁上颚具磨板、磨突与缘齿，似同种工蚁上颚；端齿鱼钩状

evidence.quote: In addition, the apical tooth is hook-shaped in Curvitermes, reduced in Cyrilliotermes; and cylindrical and elongated frontal tube in the Cyrilliotermes soldier
evidence.locator: Plazi treatment 03BB783D-FFB3-5729-FF38-92CB7F7000A8, Comparison with other genera of Syntermitinae
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/cyrilliotermes/，兵蚁上颚端齿退化、额管圆柱形延长

evidence.quote: The worker gut of Biratermes gen. n. is easily distinguishable from Embiratermes s.s. (represented in the Fig. 4, E. festivellus as an example): the mesenteric tongue is straight and does not reach the dilated portion of the P1 (Figs 4c, 4e), whereas in the Biratermes gen. n., it is arched and reaches the dilated portion of the P1 (Figs 3c, 3e) and shows a filiform connection; the P2 is located at the abdomen mid-length (Fig. 4b, arrow), whereas in Biratermes it is located distally as in other members of the Syntermitinae (Fig. 3b, arrow).
evidence.locator: Plazi treatment 03BB783D-FFB3-5729-FF38-92CB7F7000A8, The most relevant comparisons
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/embiratermes/，工蚁中肠舌直、不达 P1 膨大部；P2 位于腹部中点（而非近端）

evidence.quote: The soldiers of Embiratermes s.s. have piercing mandibles with marginal teeth at the proximal third of the mandible length, in Bandeiratermes gen. n. the mandibles are blunter and the marginal teeth are reduced, located at the base of the mandibles
evidence.locator: Plazi treatment 03BB783D-FFBA-5720-FF38-96DA78F80064, Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/embiratermes/，兵蚁缘齿位于上颚近端 1/3

evidence.quote: The worker gut of Ibitermes s.s. have a long and twisted mesenteric tongue (short and rounded in Bandeiratermes gen. n.), and the enteric valve segment is dorsally oriented (ventrally oriented in Bandeiratermes gen. n.).
evidence.locator: Plazi treatment 03BB783D-FFBA-5720-FF38-96DA78F80064, Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/ibitermes/，工蚁中肠舌长而扭曲、肠瓣段背向

evidence.quote: while those of Acangaobitermes Rocha, Cancello & Cuezzo and Noirotitermes Cancello & Myles are smaller with piercing mandibles; with the soldier of Acangaobitermes possessing an oblong head capsule and that of Noirotitermes with a remarkably distinctive shape to the head capsule. In both of the latter genera, there is a characteristic microsculpture present on the surface of the head capsule.
evidence.locator: Plazi treatment 03BB783D-FFB3-5729-FF38-92CB7F7000A8, Comparison with other genera of Syntermitinae
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/noirotitermes/，兵蚁体型较小、上颚穿刺型、头囊形状特异、头表具特征性微刻纹

sources.notes: 为 3 个属（拜拉白蚁属、班代拉白蚁属、瓦宁白蚁属）提供属级形态文本；本记录逐字摘录合计 1434 字符。

evidence.quote: can be easily distinguished from other members of Nasutitermitinae, except Velocitermes and Diversitermes, by the presence of three types of soldiers and a pair of vestigial ocelli (described below) on the soldier's head
evidence.note: 支撑：三型兵蚁 + 一对退化单眼，仅本属与 Velocitermes、Diversitermes 具——鉴别要点。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Trimorphic. Head capsule of major soldier broad, rounded, almost square or slightly oval, without constriction behind antennae (M. globiceps, sp. n.), occasionally very slightly constricted (some individuals in M. fritzi, sp. n.), oval or slightly oval in intermediate soldier.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁三型；大型兵头近方形或略卵形、触角后无收缩，中型兵头卵形——兵蚁节。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Worker: Dimorphic, the minor worker occurs rarely. Major worker has two types of mandibles (termed narrow- and broad-gap by Fontes, 1987). Head rounded (Fig. 3), antennae with 14 articles, postclypeus not inflated, fontanelle inconspicuous
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/muelleritermes/，工蚁二型（小型罕见）、大型工上颚两式 narrow-gap/broad-gap、头圆、触角 14、后唇基不膨大、囟不显

evidence.quote: Soldier: Trimorphic. Head capsule of major soldier broad, rounded, almost square or slightly oval, without constriction behind antennae (M. globiceps, sp. n.), occasionally very slightly constricted (some individuals in M. fritzi, sp. n.), oval or slightly oval in intermediate soldier.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/muelleritermes/，兵蚁三型；大型兵头宽圆近方形或略卵形，触角后无收缩（M. globiceps）或极轻微收缩（M. fritzi）

evidence.quote: Behind antennae of all soldiers are a few vestigial ommatids, and between base of nasus and base of antennae, in profile, is a kind of lens, reminiscent of a vestigial ocellus, not very clear in the figures.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/muelleritermes/，兵蚁触角后具退化单眼（vestigial ommatids），鼻基与触角基之间呈晶状体状，似退化单眼

evidence.quote: Muelleritermes gen. nov. can be easily distinguished from other members of Nasutitermitinae, except Velocitermes and Diversitermes, by the presence of three types of soldiers and a pair of vestigial ocelli (described below) on the soldier's head.
evidence.locator: Plazi treatment 1359FD17-FFDD-FFB9-C3FC-FBAAFE360CC5, Comparisons with other Nasutitermitinae genera
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/muelleritermes/，仅本属与 Velocitermes、Diversitermes 具三型兵蚁及退化单眼

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. Worker and imago. Fontanelle very large in dorsal view, ranging from 1/4 to 3/4 the diameter of the head capsule (Figs. 1B; 2A, C, E); two rows of spine-like bristles on the inner face of the protibia
evidence.note: 支撑：囟极大（1/4–3/4）+ 前足胫节两列刺状刚毛——鉴别要点。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Mono- or dimorphic (Figs. 2; 3 B–D, H, 4, 5). Head capsule flattened dorsoventrally in profile, rounded in dorsal view. Fontanelle margins well delineated, depressed within vertex, occupying 1/4 to 3/4 of the head capsule (Fig. 2A, C, E, see histological discussion below). Antenna with 14 articles. Postclypeus moderately to highly inflated.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头形、囟缘与大小、触角 14、后唇基膨大——工蚁节。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Head capsule trapezoidal in dorsal view, flattened dorsoventrally in profile (Fig. 1A, B). Two frontal marks located in dorsal view between the postclypeus and ocellus, above the antenna insertion (Fig. 1B, arrows), larger than the ocelli, and two smaller triangular marks between the frontal marks and the fontanelle
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫头背视梯形；额斑位于后唇基与单眼之间、触角着生处上方，大于单眼；额斑与囟之间另有较小的三角斑——有翅成虫节。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: In reference to the character Friar Tuck, the supposed Franciscan monk of the legend of Robin Hood.
evidence.note: 支撑：tucki 纪念罗宾汉传说人物 Friar Tuck

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. Worker and imago. Fontanelle very large in dorsal view, ranging from 1/4 to 3/4 the diameter of the head capsule (Figs. 1B; 2A, C, E); two rows of spine-like bristles on the inner face of the protibia (Fig. 3 A–C).
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/tonsuritermes/，工蚁与有翅成虫囟极大，占头宽 1/4 至 3/4；前足胫节内面具两列刺状刚毛

evidence.quote: Head capsule trapezoidal in dorsal view, flattened dorsoventrally in profile (Fig. 1A, B). Two frontal marks located in dorsal view between the postclypeus and ocellus, above the antenna insertion (Fig. 1B, arrows), larger than the ocelli, and two smaller triangular marks between the frontal marks and the fontanelle (Fig. 1B).
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/tonsuritermes/，有翅成虫头背视梯形；额斑大于单眼，另有二小三角形斑位于额斑与囟之间

evidence.quote: Worker. Mono- or dimorphic (Figs. 2; 3 B–D, H, 4, 5). Head capsule flattened dorsoventrally in profile, rounded in dorsal view. Fontanelle margins well delineated, depressed within vertex, occupying 1/4 to 3/4 of the head capsule (Fig. 2A, C, E, see histological discussion below). Antenna with 14 articles. Postclypeus moderately to highly inflated.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/tonsuritermes/，工蚁单型或二型、头侧视扁平背视圆、囟缘清晰凹陷于头顶、占头宽 1/4 至 3/4、触角 14 节、后唇基中等至高度膨大；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

authors: Figueiredo, R. E. C. R. de
sources.license: unknown（Plazi 收录的 treatment XML；文章授权条款未核实）
sources.retrieved_via: Plazi treatment XML（03B06032E118CE0B5ED6F9CAFC49FCE4）→ 去标签纯文本

evidence.quote: Enteric valve seating (EVS) forms a well-defined ring at the enteric valve (EV) insertion, followed by a short tubular portion of P3. It also features a mesenteric tongue with a whitish spherical mesenteric nodule in ventral view. EV with three semi-spherical sclerotized plates.
evidence.locator: pp. 383–396，「Diagnosis」段（Plazi treatment；PDF 分页未逐页核对）
evidence.note: 支撑：EVS 环、中肠结节、三块硬化板——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Monomorphic, with a pale-yellow head covered by sparsely spaced bristles of the same color. Head slightly convex in profile, post-clypeal region inflated, and fontanelle not visible. Antenna composed of 14 segments, with relative lengths 2>3=4<5.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁单型、体色、后唇基区、触角 14 节及相对长度——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: The gizzard is inconspicuous and unarmed and follows the pattern found in most soil-termites, being underdeveloped, with four first-order pulvilli, and the pulvilli surface with pectinated scales.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/triclavitermes/，砂囊不显、无刺，四个一级垫，垫面栉状鳞

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. Enteric valve seating (EVS) forms a well-defined ring at the enteric valve (EV) insertion, followed by a short tubular portion of P3. It also features a mesenteric tongue with a whitish spherical mesenteric nodule in ventral view. EV with three semi-spherical sclerotized plates.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/triclavitermes/，肠瓣座 EVS 在 EV 插入处成清晰环、后接 P3 短管；中肠舌腹面白色球形中肠结节；肠瓣三块半球形硬化板

evidence.quote: Worker. External morphology (Fig. 1): Monomorphic, with a pale-yellow head covered by sparsely spaced bristles of the same color. Head slightly convex in profile, post-clypeal region inflated, and fontanelle not visible. Antenna composed of 14 segments, with relative lengths 2>3=4<5.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/triclavitermes/，单型工蚁、头淡黄、侧视微凸、后唇基区膨大、囟不可见、触角 14 节、相对长度 2>3=4<5
