sources.title: Neotropical termites: revision of Armitermes Wasmann (Isoptera, Termitidae, Syntermitinae) and phylogeny of the Syntermitinae
sources.license: unknown（Wiley 出版社版权；所读为订阅刊 PDF，非 OA 授权）
sources.retrieved_via: 出版社 PDF（_tmp/lit/pdf/armitermes2012.pdf）→ PyMuPDF 抽文本，保留原排版断行连字符

evidence.quote: The soldier of Silvestritermes gen.n. can be distinguished from Armitermes because the former lacks a row of short thick spines on the margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum
evidence.note: 支撑：前、中、后胸背板边缘无一行短粗刺，可与 Armitermes 区分——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Soldier. Monomorphic. Head capsule, in dorsal view, rounded or with lateral margins rounded with angular lateral posterior corners. Frontal tube conical, in dorsal view extending beyond the labrum
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁单型、头形、额管背视伸出上唇——兵蚁节。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded, with inconspicuous epicranial suture; fontanelle oval, but very inconspicuous (except in Silvestritermes lanei). Postclypeus and labrum as in imago. Antennae with 13 or 14 articles
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁单型、头圆、囟极不显（lanei 除外）、触角 13/14 节——工蚁节。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: The soldier of Uncitermes gen.n. is easily distinguished from Armitermes by the hooked mandibles, the absence of a conspicuous row of short thick spines on the margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum, and the lack of keel-shaped projections and thick bristles on the forecoxae.
evidence.note: 支撑：钩状上颚、无背板短粗刺列、前基节无龙骨突起与粗刚毛——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Soldier. Monomorphic. Head capsule, in dorsal view, rounded. Frontal tube conical, same length as base of head capsule; forming a nearly 45° angle with base of head, in profile. Antennae with 15 articles. Labrum rounded, anterior margin hyaline, without distinct tip. Postmentum sub-rectangular
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头圆、额管与头基等长、触角 15、上唇圆、后颏近长方形——兵蚁节。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded; epicranial suture inconspicuous; fontanelle oval, little visible. Antennae with 15 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁单型、头圆、囟不明显、触角 15 节——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: Also, the gizzard pulvilli in Mapinguaritermes gen.n. is ornamented with well-developed spines, which is also a synapomorphy of the new genus in our analysis.
evidence.note: 支撑：砂囊一级垫具发达刺，为本属共衍征——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Head capsule oval, in dorsal view. Frontal tube conical, almost parallel to base of head capsule, and approximately four-fifths of its length in profile. Antennae with 14 articles. Labrum almost pentagonal, anterior margin hyaline, without distinct tip. Postmentum with concave sides. Piercing mandibles symmetrical; only one marginal tooth, acute and inward-orientated
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头卵形、额管约为头基长的 4/5、触角 14 节、上唇近五边形、后颏两侧凹、上颚仅一枚内向锐齿——兵蚁节。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded; epicranial suture not evident; fontanelle oval, but very discreet. Postclypeus little inflated. Antennae with 14 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁单型、头圆、囟很不明显、后唇基稍膨大、触角 14 节——工蚁节。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Laminar mandibles, with an incision anterior to the first marginal teeth; postmentum finely rugose; Mexico, Belize and Honduras
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 11
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚片状、第一缘齿前具切刻；后颏细皱；分布于墨西哥至洪都拉斯。

evidence.quote: Mandibles with the molar region enlarged and a posteriorly pointed subapical tooth
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 7
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚磨区扩大、具向后指的亚端齿，据此与无此特征的类群（9 支）分开。

evidence.quote: Frontal tube with a smooth surface; broad and conical.
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 8
evidence.note: 支撑：额管表面光滑、宽锥形（与 Cyrilliotermes 的皱褶环状端相对）。

evidence.quote: Frontal tube wrinkled with irregular transverse ridges and with a doughnut-shaped tip
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 8
evidence.note: 支撑：额管具不规则横脊而皱褶、端部环状（doughnut-shaped）。

evidence.quote: Mandibles with a recognisable marginal tooth, near the middle or near the base; clypeus not inflated.
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 12
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚具可辨缘齿（近中部或基部），唇基不膨大。

evidence.quote: Head capsule elongate and sub-rectangular in dorsal view; length of base of head capsule normally more than the width
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 10
evidence.note: 支撑：头囊背面观延长、近长方形，头基部长大于宽。

evidence.quote: Mandibles without marginal teeth; clypeus strongly inflated (except in I. tellustris Constantino)
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 12
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚无缘齿、唇基强烈膨大（I. tellustris 除外）。

evidence.quote: marginal tooth on the middle of mandibles, dimorphic soldiers
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 6
evidence.note: 支撑：上颚缘齿位于中部，兵蚁二型。

evidence.quote: Posterior region of head with four conspicuous protuberances resembling horns; sides convex, with a slight constriction at the anterior half
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 14
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头后部具四个角状显著突起，两侧凸、前半略收缢。

evidence.quote: Piercing mandibles, with a conspicuous marginal tooth near the base; South America
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 11
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚穿刺型、基部附近具显著缘齿。

evidence.quote: Head capsule rounded or sub-quadrate; length of the base of head capsule almost equal to width
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 10
evidence.note: 支撑：头囊圆或近方形，头基部长约等于宽。

evidence.quote: Soldier. Monomorphic. Head capsule, in dorsal view, rounded or with lateral margins rounded with angular lateral posterior corners. Frontal tube conical, in dorsal view extending beyond the labrum and forming an angle of approximately 45° with the head capsule inferior margin in profile. Antennae with 13 or 14 articles, varying according to the species.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/silvestritermes/，兵蚁单型；头背视圆或侧缘圆而后侧角成角；额管圆锥形、背视伸出上唇；触角 13–14 节。

evidence.quote: Labrum almost pentagonal, with plain hyaline margin, not projected. Postmentum sub-rectangular. Piercing mandibles with variable outer margin, from slightly angled in middle to continuous and uniform along entire length; molar region well developed, similar to that in the worker. Left mandible with perpendicular marginal tooth, which may be blunt or sinuous, varying according to the species. Right mandible with two marginal teeth, the first triangular and acute or blunt, varying according to the species; and the second reduced, situated near the base and visible only in ventral view or by dissection of the mandible (Fig. 27D, arrow). Forecoxae without projections on the outer margins.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/silvestritermes/，上唇近五边形、透明缘平而不突出；后颏近长方形；兵蚁上颚穿刺型、磨区发达似工蚁；前足基节外缘无突起。

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded, with inconspicuous epicranial suture; fontanelle oval, but very inconspicuous (except in Silvestritermes lanei). Postclypeus and labrum as in imago. Antennae with 13 or 14 articles, varying according to the species. Forecoxae without lateral projections. Abdomen oval, translucent. Head pilosity as in imago, and on remainder of body as in soldier. Tibial spur 2:2:2.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/silvestritermes/，工蚁单型；头圆、额缝不显；囟椭圆但极不显（S. lanei 除外）；触角 13–14 节；前足基节无侧突。

evidence.quote: Digestive tube (worker). Gizzard: columnar belt with 24 visible folds, 6 of the first order, 6 of second, and 12 of third; pulvilli without ornamentation.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/silvestritermes/，工蚁砂囊柱状带 24 条可见褶（一级 6、二级 6、三级 12），垫（pulvilli）无饰。

evidence.quote: Comparisons. The soldier of Silvestritermes gen.n. can be distinguished from Armitermes because the former lacks a row of short thick spines on the margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum, and has a well-developed molar region on the mandibles. The gut morphology of Silvestritermes gen.n. is quite singular, with the P3b shape, and the enteric valve ornamentation is distinct from all other Syntermitinae species. The closest genus to Silvestritermes gen.n. in the phylogeny was Curvitermes, which can be easily distinguished by the soldiers with the mandibles short, with a more marked molar region, and a fishhook-shaped apical tooth (Fig. 3C) (see Carvalho & Constantino, 2011 for accurate descriptions of Curvitermes species).
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/silvestritermes/，与 Armitermes 的区别为前、中、后胸背板边缘无一行短粗刺且上颚磨区发达；并指出最近缘属 Curvitermes 的兵蚁上颚短、磨区更明显、端齿鱼钩状。原文此处将 Syntermitinae 误拼为 Syntermtinae，照录。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldier. Monomorphic. Head capsule, in dorsal view, rounded. Frontal tube conical, same length as base of head capsule; forming a nearly 45° angle with base of head, in profile. Antennae with 15 articles. Labrum rounded, anterior margin hyaline, without distinct tip. Postmentum sub-rectangular. Mandibles symmetrical, piercing and hooked; tip of mandible pointing posteriorly in rest position; only one perpendicular and quite acute marginal tooth on each mandible; molar region indistinct. Forecoxae without projections. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/uncitermes/，兵蚁单型；头背视圆；额管圆锥形、与头基等长、侧视近 45°；触角 15 节；上唇圆、前缘透明无明显尖；后颏近长方形；上颚对称、穿刺而钩状、静止时尖端向后，各具一枚垂直而颇尖的缘齿，磨区不显；前足基节无突起。

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded; epicranial suture inconspicuous; fontanelle oval, little visible. Antennae with 15 articles. Forecoxae without projections. Abdomen oval and translucent. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/uncitermes/，工蚁单型；头圆、额缝不显；囟椭圆、不明显；触角 15 节；前足基节无突起。

evidence.quote: The most similar genus to Uncitermes is Rhynchotermes [particularly the species R. perarmatus (Snyder) and R. bulbinasus Scheffrahn]. Although the possibility of transferring U. teevani to Rhynchotermes could be raised, after a comparative analysis with all Rhynchotermes species, we noted that many of the diagnostic characters of Rhynchotermes, particularly those of the worker caste, do not conform to U. teevani. These characters are: the laterally pointed projection on the forecoxae of the soldier and worker; the shape of the worker mandibles, with a small apical tooth; a long cutting edge between the M1 + 2 and M3, and a conspicuous ridge on the molar plate; P1 fusiform; mesenteric tongue elongated and constricted at the insertion on the mesenteron; and enteric valve reduced to three small bulbs.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/uncitermes/，与最相似属 Rhynchotermes 的对比：后者兵蚁与工蚁前足基节具侧向尖突、工蚁上颚端齿小、磨板具明显脊等，而 U. teevani 不符。原文将 mesenteric 拼作 mensenteric，照录。；OCR 讹字已按上下文校正

evidence.quote: Soldier. Monomorphic. Head capsule oval, in dorsal view. Frontal tube conical, almost parallel to base of head capsule, and approximately four-fifths of its length in profile. Antennae with 14 articles. Labrum almost pentagonal, anterior margin hyaline, without distinct tip. Postmentum with concave sides. Piercing mandibles symmetrical; only one marginal tooth, acute and inward-orientated; molar region reduced. Pronotum with rounded or angular sides, sometimes varying on each side of the same specimen. Forecoxae without projections. Head pilosity varying, depending on the species. Pronotum with bristles on entire surface of anterior lobe, and on margins of posterior lobe. Meso- and metanotum with bristles on posterior margin; legs with sparse bristles and short hairs. Tergites and sternites with short hairs, but only sternites with bristles on posterior margin. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/mapinguaritermes/，兵蚁单型；头背视卵形；额管圆锥形、几与头基平行、侧视长约头基 4/5；触角 14 节；上唇近五边形、前缘透明无明显尖；后颏两侧凹；上颚对称、穿刺型，仅一枚向内尖缘齿，磨区退化；前足基节无突起。

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded; epicranial suture not evident; fontanelle oval, but very discreet. Postclypeus little inflated. Antennae with 14 articles. Abdomen oval, translucent. Head with sparse bristles; postclypeus with only two pairs of bristles and some microscopic hairs; body pilosity as in the soldier. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/mapinguaritermes/，工蚁单型；头圆、额缝不显；囟椭圆、很不明显；后唇基稍膨大；触角 14 节。

evidence.quote: Digestive tube (Fig. 41C–G). Gizzard: columnar belt with 24 visible folds, 6 first-, 6 second-, and 12 third-order; pulvilli I (major) well ornamented with conspicuous spines of variable size (see Fig. 42B).
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/mapinguaritermes/，工蚁砂囊柱状带 24 条可见褶（一级 6、二级 6、三级 12）；第一级垫饰有大小不一的显著刺。

evidence.quote: Our decision to remove M. grandidens and M. peruanus from Armitermes is justified by the absence of a conspicuous row of short thick spines on the margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum, and the lack of keel-shaped projections or thick bristles on the forecoxae of the soldiers and workers of these species. Also, the gizzard pulvilli in Mapinguaritermes gen.n. is ornamented with well-developed spines, which is also a synapomorphy of the new genus in our analysis.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/mapinguaritermes/，从 Armitermes 分出本属的依据：前、中、后胸背板边缘无一行短粗刺，兵蚁与工蚁前足基节无龙骨状突起或粗刚毛；砂囊垫具发达刺，为作者分析中的本属共衍征。

evidence.quote: Head capsule rounded or sub-quadrate; length of the base of head capsule almost equal to width.
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 10 (lead to couplet 11)
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/cahuallitermes/，检索表 couplet 10 前项：头囊圆或近方形，头基部长约等于宽；Cahuallitermes 位于其后的 couplet 11。

evidence.quote: Laminar mandibles, with an incision anterior to the first marginal teeth; postmentum finely rugose; Mexico, Belize and Honduras. Cahuallitermes Constantino
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 11
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/cahuallitermes/，兵蚁上颚片状、第一缘齿之前具切刻；后颏细皱；分布于墨西哥、伯利兹与洪都拉斯。

evidence.quote: Another group is composed by Cahuallitermes, Cornitermes, Labiotermes, Procornitermes and Syntermes. The exact relationship among these genera is unclear, but they certainly form a monophyletic group. This group is characterised by the presence of a hyaline tip of the labrum projected; a short frontal tube (reverted in Cahuallitermes); and a secondary mesenteric tongue, that may be reduced or absent in a few species.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/cahuallitermes/，本属所在的单系群以突出的上唇透明端、短额管（原文注 Cahuallitermes 为反转）及次级中肠舌为特征。

evidence.quote: Fig. 7. Soldier postmentum. (A) concave lateral margins (Orthognathotermes insignis); (B) rectilinear or convex lateral margins (Cahuallitermes aduncus).
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/cahuallitermes/，图 7B 示 Cahuallitermes aduncus 兵蚁后颏侧缘直或凸（与凹缘的 Orthognathotermes 对比）。

evidence.quote: Mandibles with the molar region enlarged and a posteriorly pointed subapical tooth (Fig. 8G, H)
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 7
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/curvitermes/，兵蚁上颚磨区扩大并具向后指的亚端齿（图 8G, H 示之）。

evidence.quote: Frontal tube with a smooth surface; broad and conical. Curvitermes Holmgren
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 8
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/curvitermes/，兵蚁额管表面光滑、宽锥形。

evidence.quote: The closest genus to Silvestritermes gen.n. in the phylogeny was Curvitermes, which can be easily distinguished by the soldiers with the mandibles short, with a more marked molar region, and a fishhook-shaped apical tooth (Fig. 3C)
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/curvitermes/，与 Silvestritermes 对比时明确指出 Curvitermes 兵蚁上颚短、磨区更明显、端齿鱼钩状（图 3C）。

evidence.quote: the first marginal teeth of Curvitermes and Cyrilliotermes (Figs 2A–C, 3A–C) are not homologous to the first marginal teeth of other Syntermitinae (Figs 4A–C, 5A–D); therefore, we coded them as ‘subapical tooth’.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/curvitermes/，作者据白兵蚁观察认为 Curvitermes 与 Cyrilliotermes 的第一缘齿与其他 Syntermitinae 的第一缘齿非同源，故编码为“亚端齿”（subapical tooth）。

evidence.quote: Frontal tube wrinkled with irregular transverse ridges and with a doughnut-shaped tip; long and cylindrical in the majority of species (except for C. crassinasus Constantino & Carvalho, which is broadly conical); Cyrilliotermes Fontes
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 8
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/cyrilliotermes/，兵蚁额管皱褶、具不规则横脊，端部环状（doughnut-shaped）；多数种长而圆柱形，C. crassinasus 为宽锥形。

evidence.quote: this character defines the group comprising Paracurvitermes [Cyrilliotermes (Curvitermes, Silvestritermes)], which is supported by the persistence of the molar region in the soldier mandibles. The species of this group are the smallest Syntermitinae
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/cyrilliotermes/，本属所在的 Paracurvitermes 支系以兵蚁上颚磨区持续存在为特征，且为 Syntermitinae 中体型最小的类群。

evidence.quote: Mandibles with a recognisable marginal tooth, near the middle or near the base; clypeus not inflated. Embiratermes Fontes
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 12
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/embiratermes/，兵蚁上颚具可辨认的缘齿（近中部或近基部），后唇基不膨大。

evidence.quote: Head capsule elongate and sub-rectangular in dorsal view; length of base of head capsule normally more than the width.
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 10 (lead to couplet 12)
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/embiratermes/，检索表 couplet 10 后项：头囊背视延长、近长方形，头基部长通常大于宽；Embiratermes 位于其后的 couplet 12。

evidence.quote: Mandibles without marginal teeth; clypeus strongly inflated (except in I. tellustris Constantino). Ibitermes Fontes
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 12
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/ibitermes/，兵蚁上颚无缘齿；后唇基显著膨大（I. tellustris 例外）。

evidence.quote: Lateral margins of pro-, meso- and metanotum serrated (Figs 21A, 23A, 25A)
evidence.locator: p. 804, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 5
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/macuxitermes/，检索表 couplet 5 前项：前、中、后胸背板侧缘锯齿状；Macuxitermes 位于其后的 couplet 6。

evidence.quote: Head capsule, in dorsal view, with two antero-lateral protuberances; marginal tooth on the middle of mandibles, dimorphic soldiers. Macuxitermes Cancello & Bandeira
evidence.locator: p. 804, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 6
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/macuxitermes/，兵蚁头背视具两个前侧突起；上颚缘齿位于中部；兵蚁二型。

evidence.quote: Head capsule surface punctuated (visible only under high magnification, 40–50×); angular protuberances on the posterior sides of head capsule (less evident in Acangaobitermes); mandibles very slender, each with a small acute marginal tooth
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 13
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/noirotitermes/，检索表 couplet 13 前项：头囊表面具刻点（40–50× 下可见），头囊后侧具角状突起，上颚细长、各具一枚小尖缘齿；Noirotitermes 位于其后的 couplet 14。

evidence.quote: Posterior region of head with four conspicuous protuberances resembling horns; sides convex, with a slight constriction at the anterior half, two pairs of protuberances at rear part of head, first pair dorsally located, the second and smaller pair laterally placed; pronotum without a marked angle between the anterior and posterior lobe. Noirotitermes Cancello & Myles
evidence.locator: p. 806, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 14
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/noirotitermes/，兵蚁头后部具四个角状显著突起，两侧凸、前半略收缢；头后两对突起，第一对背位、第二对较小且侧位；前胸背板前后叶间无明显角。

evidence.quote: The group composed of Macuxitermes (Noirotitermes, Acangaobitermes) is supported by the presence of occipital protuberances and the characteristic microsculpture of the soldier head capsules.
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/noirotitermes/，本属所在支系以头后突起（occipital protuberances）及兵蚁头囊特征性微刻纹为共有衍征。

evidence.quote: 10(9). Head capsule rounded or sub-quadrate; length of the base of head capsule almost equal to width.
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 10 (lead to couplet 11)
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/paracurvitermes/，检索表 couplet 10 前项：头囊圆或近方形，头基部长约等于宽；Paracurvitermes 位于其后的 couplet 11。

evidence.quote: Piercing mandibles, with a conspicuous marginal tooth near the base; South America. Paracurvitermes Constantino & Carvalho
evidence.locator: p. 805, Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 11
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/paracurvitermes/，兵蚁上颚穿刺型，基部附近具显著缘齿；分布南美洲。

evidence.quote: The species of this group are the smallest Syntermitinae
evidence.note: 支撑：/genus/paracurvitermes/，本属所在的 Paracurvitermes 支系为 Syntermitinae 中体型最小的类群（同段前文以兵蚁上颚磨区持续存在为本支系特征）。

sources.notes: 全文存于 _unpublished/文库/Termites-of-the-Belgian-Congo-and-the-Cameroon（391457 字符），抽取：text；文本由 PDF/XML 抽取，不是排版原貌：上标引文编号、表格、图注可能错位，正式引用前须核对出版方原文。；archive.org 全文镜像：https://archive.org/details/bulletin-american-museum-natural-history-57-401-574

evidence.quote: owing to the fact that the pulvillus is lacking
evidence.note: 支撑：种加词 sepulvillus = se-（无）+ pulvillus（小爪垫）= 无爪垫，对应其鉴别特征

evidence.quote: Front of head overlapping base of mandibles. Fastigitermes. Front of head not overlapping base of mandibles. Basidentitermes.
evidence.note: 支撑：基齿白蚁属（/genus/basidentitermes/）

evidence.quote: This peculiar subgenus also is known from only a few localities so that its distribution (Map 20) is problematical.
evidence.note: 支撑：基齿白蚁属（/genus/basidentitermes/）

evidence.quote: 20. —Labrum large and fleshy. Euchihtermes.
evidence.note: 支撑：真唇白蚁属（/genus/euchilotermes/）

evidence.quote: This group up to the present time has been known only from one species and its varieties, E. tensus Silvestri, which he described as a new genus in 1914.
evidence.note: 支撑：真唇白蚁属（/genus/euchilotermes/）

evidence.quote: 23. —Front of head overlapping base of mandibles. Fastigitermes.
evidence.note: 支撑：峰白蚁属（/genus/fastigitermes/）

evidence.quote: Ophiotermes differs from the other subgenera of Mirotermes and closely related genera, in the shape of the mandibles, which are bent outward near the middle and are somewhat curved inwards near the tip.
evidence.note: 支撑：蛇白蚁属（/genus/ophiotermes/）

evidence.quote: A small, but conspicuous tooth is present between the base and the elbow on the inner side of both mandibles. The prothoracic tibiae have three spines at the apex and the meso- and metathoracic tibiae have two spines at the apex. The gland opening is similar to that found in the subgenus Cubitermes. The labrum is two-lobed.
evidence.note: 支撑：蛇白蚁属（/genus/ophiotermes/）

evidence.quote: Front of head prolonged into a very large conspicuous nose; sides of head rounded. Proboscitermes. Front of head not prolonged into a nose; sides of head straight and parallel. Orthotermes .
evidence.note: 支撑：象鼻白蚁属（/genus/proboscitermes/）

evidence.quote: Front of head prolonged into a very large conspicuous nose; sides of head rounded. Proboscitermes. Front of head not prolonged into a nose; sides of head straight and parallel. Orthotermes .
evidence.note: 支撑：小瘤白蚁属（/genus/tuberculitermes/）

evidence.quote: Head yellowish; rectangular; sides fairly straight and parallel. Antennae with 14 segments, the third longer than the second, the second equal to the fourth. Labrum forked, the points not always as wide apart as in the figure. Mandibles somewhat elbowed instead of being evenly curved, a tooth near the base of each mandible. Gula with no sharp projection.
evidence.note: 支撑：原方白蚁属兵蚁（M. niapuensis）

evidence.quote: Head medium dark red-brown; fontanelle slit-shaped, light. Antennae with 15 segments, the third very small, the second equal to the fourth. Eyes of medium size. Ocelli .14 mm. long, oval, facing sideways, 1.10 mm. from the eyes. Postclypeus slightly lighter than the head, with narrow dark median line. Pronotum a little lighter than the head, posterior margin rather deeply emarginate.
evidence.note: 支撑：原方白蚁属有翅成虫（M. niapuensis）

evidence.quote: Head reddish yellow; rectangular; sides straight and parallel; gula without sharp projection. Antennae with 14 segments, the second equal to the third, the fourth shorter than the third. Labrum deeply cut, each tip fairly sharp. Mandibles with a small tooth near the base of each; left mandible not evenly curved, but elbowed in two places; right mandible evenly curved.
evidence.note: 支撑：原方白蚁属兵蚁（M. undulans）

evidence.quote: Head yellowish brown; oval; fontanelle small, white; three muscle insertions in front of the fontanelle. The third segment of the antennae about twice as long as the second or fourth, showing signs of division. Eyes of medium size, close to the lower margin.
evidence.note: 支撑：原方白蚁属有翅成虫（M. undulans）

evidence.quote: No projecting spines on the sides of the meso- and metanotum. Pseudacanthotermes.
evidence.note: 支撑：伪刺白蚁属与 Acanthotermes 的检索鉴别

evidence.quote: Head rectangular, reddish yellow brown. Antennae with 19-21 segments. Labrum wide with hyaline tip. Mandibles black, the left coarsely dentate. Fontanelle surrounded by short hairs and a spine in front. Meso- and metanota with pointed sides but with no lateral spines. Pronotum with two large spines on the anterior margin, the sides sharply pointed and converging toward the rear.
evidence.note: 支撑：伪刺白蚁属大兵蚁（A. spiniger）

evidence.quote: Head dark brown, mandibles yellowish with black tips. Antennae with 23 segments, the second longer than the third, the third and fourth equal. Eyes relatively small, as far from the lower margin as from the ocelli. Ocelli elongate from above, oval from the side, more than their diameter from the eyes. Labrum yellowish. Postclypeus yellowish, contrasting with the head; a line through the middle.
evidence.note: 支撑：伪刺白蚁属有翅成虫（A. spiniger）

evidence.quote: For the present I am regarding Pseudacanthotermes as a subgenus. The genus as a whole seems to be successful in Rain Forests as well as in the Savanna. Large fungus gardens are found in the nests.
evidence.note: 支撑：伪刺白蚁属的分类地位与菌圃习性

evidence.quote: Head yellow; strongly narrowed in front; sides fairly straight. Antennae with 14 segments, the third very long (.22-32 mm.), the second and fourth about equal. Labrum with a concave anterior margin ending in two sharp points. Mandibles long and slender, black, adapted for snapping.
evidence.note: 支撑：前奇白蚁属兵蚁（M. orthoceps）

evidence.quote: Head reddish yellow-brown with a darker nose; conspicuously constricted in the middle; two hairs on the vertex.
evidence.note: 支撑：缩狭白蚁属兵蚁（N. suffuscus）头与缢缩

evidence.quote: The third segment is longer than the second or fourth but is not double the length of the second as in N. dorise. Mandibles with very small points which are barely distinguishable.
evidence.note: 支撑：缩狭白蚁属兵蚁触角与上颚点

evidence.quote: Head rectangular with rounded angles, only slightly narrowed in front; reddish yellow; covered with short hair. Antennae with 13 segments, the third smaller than the second, the second equal to the fourth. Labrum with rounded sides and a hyaline point.
evidence.note: 支撑：圆球白蚁属兵蚁头、触角、上唇

evidence.quote: Left mandible with a much stronger curved point than the right, a few serrations and a blunt tooth near the base. Inner margin of the right mandible smooth. Fontanelle in the middle of the head, small and inconspicuous.
evidence.note: 支撑：圆球白蚁属兵蚁上颚与囟门

evidence.quote: Head light brownish yellow; oval; fontanelle a round light dot and rather small; head covered with short hairs and a few long bristles. The third segment of the antennae very small, the fourth about equal to the second. Eyes of medium size, round, not particularly close to the lower margin. Ocelli large, very close to the eyes.
evidence.note: 支撑：圆球白蚁属有翅成虫头、触角、眼、单眼

evidence.quote:
Macrotermes (Bellicositermes) natalensis (Haviland)

Plates XXIII, Figure 1; XXIV; XXV; XXVI; Text Figure 14
Imago. —Head dark brown, oval; fontanelle inconspicuous, same color as head.
The third segment of the antennae longest, the second and the fourth equal. Eyes
rather large, oval. Ocelli. 165 m
evidence.note: 支撑：Emerson 1928 条目以「学名独占一行 + Imago./Soldier.」结构给种级描述（A 类判据）

evidence.quote:
Imago. —Head brown; oval; rather thickly covered with long hairs. Fontanelle 
a small dot in the middle of the forehead. Antennae with 19 segments, the third 
slightly smaller than the fourth, the fourth shorter than the second. Eyes rather 
large and fairly close to the lower margin of the head.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫头/触角/眼/单眼形态与触角节数（19 节）

evidence.quote:
Soldier.— Head reddish yellow; sides slightly rounded, converging toward the 
front; a few bristles scattered over the head. Antennae with 17 segments, the third 
smaller than the second, the fourth equal to the second. Black eye spots behind the 
bases of the antennae. Mandibles black except at the base.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头色、触角 17 节与黑眼点、上颚基部以外的黑色

evidence.quote:
Type Locality.—Region of Stanleyville, Belgian Congo: No. 22T, 
Kohl Coll.
evidence.note: 支撑：模式产地 Stanleyville 与名录一致，确认旧组合 Termes schmitzi 即本种

sources.title: A taxonomic revision of the neotropical termite genus Ruptitermes (Isoptera, Termitidae, Apicotermitinae)

evidence.quote: Imago: Head capsule rounded in dorsal view, short and broad, densely covered with short hairs and scattered bristles. Fontanelle variable, elliptical to rounded, usually conspicuous. Eyes relatively small; ocelli rounded or elliptical, distant from eyes by at least its diameter
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫头短宽而圆，囟多变，复眼较小、单眼距复眼至少其直径。

evidence.quote: Postclypeus relatively small and moderately inflated to large and inflated; depressed at both ends of the midline; midline conspicuous, depressed, and incomplete, vanishing near anterior and posterior margins.
evidence.note: 支撑：后唇基中线两端凹陷，中线明显、不完整。

evidence.quote: Antenna with 15 articles. Each tibia with two apical spurs. Wings uniformly covered with irregularly shaped micrasters, with 2–4 arms
evidence.note: 支撑：触角 15 节，各胫节 2 端距，翅面覆 2–4 臂微鳞。

evidence.quote: Head broad and rounded, usually well sclerotized and dark colored (pale colored in a few species); chaetotaxy variable. Fontanelle elliptical to rounded, small to large, of variable color, usually conspicuous. Postclypeus inflated or flattened.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头宽圆、通常骨化深色深；囟多变；后唇基膨大或扁平。

evidence.quote: A pair of rounded, well-developed dehiscent glands present in the anterior part of abdomen, filling up to 1/3 of its volume.
evidence.note: 支撑：腹部前部具一对球形发达破裂腺，可达腹部体积 1/3。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve with bilateral symmetry, bearing 6 unsclerotized, reticulated ridges (3 longer ones on one side and 3 shorter ones on the other side); spines absent in most species.
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣两侧对称、6 条无骨化网纹脊，多数种无刺。

evidence.quote: The workers of Ruptitermes are easily recognized by the presence of the dehiscent glands, which are usually conspicuous as a whitish mass in the anterior part of the abdomen.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁以腹部前部白色团块状的破裂腺易于识别。

evidence.quote: Imagoes are larger than most other neotropical Apicotermitinae. The imagoes of Aparatermes Fontes 1985 are the most similar and can be distinguished by the shape of the postclypeus, which is not depressed at the ends of the midline.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫大于多数新热带 Apicotermitinae；与 Aparatermes 以后唇基中线两端不凹陷区分。

evidence.quote: Left mandible: A shorter than M1 (except in R. bandeirai , sp.n, where they are about the same length), M3 usually very short (except in R. arboreus and R. bandeirai , sp.n); notch between M1 and M3 always present
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁左上颚端齿（A）短于第一缘齿（M1），M1–M3 之间恒有缺刻。

evidence.quote: Crop very small in most species (large only in R. arboreus ); gizzard unarmed
evidence.note: 支撑：多数种嗉囊很小，砂囊无武装。

evidence.quote: Imagos of Armitermes, Embiratermes , and Labiotermes have a left mandible index between 0.7 and 1.1, and those of the genera Curvitermes, Cyrilliotermes , and Paracurvitermes have a left mandible index around 2.0.
evidence.locator: Comparisons（属名后逗号前的空格系 Plazi 抽取标签剥离所致）

evidence.quote: Imagos of Armitermes, Embiratermes , and Labiotermes have a left mandible index between 0.7 and 1.1
evidence.locator: Comparisons（属名后逗号前的空格系 Plazi 抽取标签剥离所致）
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫左颚指数 0.7–1.1。

evidence.quote: Head capsule brown; frontal marks semicircular, paler; fontanelle spot oval, also paler; ecdisial line faint

evidence.quote: Compound eyes circular, medium sized

evidence.quote: Left mandible index 1.5. Antenna with 15 articles: 1> 2> 6> 5 = 4> 3.

evidence.quote: Wing microsculpture nearly absent, with only small punctuations in the proximal anterior portion
evidence.note: 支撑：翅面微 sculpturing 几乎缺失，仅前部近端有细点。

evidence.quote: Postclypeus conspicuously inflated ( Fig. 1 View FIGURES 1 B), with front margin straight, and hind margin convex

evidence.quote: Mandibles with large apical teeth ( Fig. 1 View FIGURES 1 H); left M3 much shorter than M1
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫上颚端齿大，左 M3 远短于 M1。

sources.title: A new termite (Isoptera, Termitidae, Syntermitinae, Macuxitermes) from Colombia

evidence.quote: The genus Macuxitermes was erected for a single species, Macuxitermes triceratops Cancello & Bandeira, 1992.
evidence.note: 支撑：属为单种属建立，后增补 M. colombicus。

evidence.quote: Soldier. Dimorphic or monomorphic.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁二型或不二型。

evidence.quote: Major soldier. Head capsule evenly rounded or with a dorsal elevation and anterior protuberance either side of the midline, entire surface covered with minute granulations.
evidence.note: 支撑：主兵头囊均匀圆或具背隆起及中线两侧前突，表面满布微颗粒。

evidence.quote: Anterior of head capsule narrows to form a robust conical nasus whose apex extends far beyond tips of mandibles
evidence.note: 支撑：头前部收狭为粗壮锥形象鼻，鼻端远超上颚末端。

evidence.quote: mandibles curved strongly inwards, apices directed laterally at rest and not upturned, each mandible with a pointed marginal tooth half-way along inner surface
evidence.note: 支撑：上颚强内弯、静止时末端指向两侧且不上翘，各具一半位尖缘齿。

evidence.quote: enteric valve narrow, on the left posterior side of the abdomen, with three finger-like cushions each bearing two rows of regularly spaced long, narrow, straight or slightly curved spines of equal length throughout
evidence.locator: Taxonomic treatment › Macuxitermes › Description › Worker, Addenda
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁肠瓣窄、位于腹部左后侧，三指状垫各具两列等长规则长刺。

evidence.quote: antennae yellow with 15 articles, I largest and III shortest; rows of dark short, tooth-like spines along the margins of the thoracic nota
evidence.locator: Taxonomic treatment › Macuxitermes › Description › Major soldier
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁触角黄色、15 节（第 I 节最长、第 III 节最短），胸部背板边缘具成列深色短齿状刺。

evidence.quote: digestive tube showing complete dorsal torsion and with small crop, long and inflated mixed segment that is proximally narrow and broadly oval distally, very large and voluminous P1
evidence.locator: Taxonomic treatment › Macuxitermes › Description › Worker, Addenda
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁消化道完全背向扭转，嗉囊小、混合段长而膨大，P1 极大而饱满。

sources.title: Redescription of the enigmatic genus Genuotermes Emerson (Isoptera, Termitidae, Termitinae)

evidence.quote: Soldier. Mandibles elongated, elbowed at proximal one-third, distal two-thirds with serrated blade on inner surface and salient tooth at base
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚延长、近端 1/3 处肘弯，远端 2/3 内缘为锯齿刃并具基部突齿。

evidence.quote: Head capsule subrectangular in dorsal view, with a characteristic frontal projection, best viewed in profile
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头囊背面观近长方形，具特征性额突（侧面观最清楚）。

evidence.quote: Frontal gland aperture at tip of head projection, oriented anteriorly.

evidence.quote: Worker. Head capsule rounded in dorsal view. Fontanelle inconspicuous. Antenna with 14-15 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头囊背面观圆，囟不明显，触角 14–15 节。

evidence.quote: P1 dilated, located on left side of body, with the final portion forming an elongated loop that reaches the dorsal region and down to insert on P3
evidence.note: 支撑：P1 膨大、位于体左侧，末段成延长环上达背区再下行接入 P3。

evidence.quote: Imago. Eyes semispherical, oval in profile, close to but not touching lower margin of head and ocellus
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫复眼半球形、侧观椭圆，接近但不触头下缘与单眼。

evidence.note: 支撑：Cristatitermes 属名词源 = cristatus 具冠，指兵蚁额突（经 Google 索引 snippet 逐字）

sources.title: New Genera of Termites Related to Subulitermes from the Oriental, Malagasy, and Australian Regions (Isoptera, Termitidae, Nasutitermitinae)
sources.notes: Aciculitermes、Ceylonitermellus、Australitermes 的原始属级描述。archive.org 扫描 OCR；引文照 OCR 文本，未作拼接。

evidence.quote: The soldier of Aciculitermes lacks points on the mandibles.
evidence.note: 针白蚁属（aciculitermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」「鉴别要点」上颚无端尖这一建属性状。

evidence.quote: Head and frontal projection with many short microscopical hairs. Vertex and base of head projection with a few bristles. Head proportionately wider than that of Subulitermes microsoma. Profile of head from tip of projection to the vertex almost straight or slightly concave, with a slight hump at the base of the projection.
evidence.note: 针白蚁属（aciculitermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」头与额突的微毛、与 Subulitermes microsoma 的头宽比较、头部侧轮廓。

evidence.quote: The left mandibular index is 0.73, while it is 0.56 for Leucopitermes and 1.33 for Subulitermes. The apical teeth of both mandibles are proportionately larger than in Leucopitermes (fig. 2), there is no notch immediately posterior to the first marginal tooth of the left mandible, and the third marginal tooth is narrower.
evidence.note: 针白蚁属（aciculitermes）：支撑：「工蚁」左颚指数 0.73 及其与 Leucopitermes、Subulitermes 的对比，端齿比例、缺刻与第 3 缘齿宽度。

evidence.quote: Eye and ocellus large, the ocellus less than its width from the ocular suture and longer (0.15 mm.) than the diameter of the basal socket of the antenna (0.12 mm.). Fontanelle long and narrowly oval, without a distinctly forked tip. Postclypeus much longer than half of its width (length, 0.32 mm.; width, 0.50 mm.).
evidence.note: 澳大利亚白蚁属（australitermes）：支撑：「有翅成虫」眼与单眼、囟、后唇基的性状与量度。

evidence.quote: Antenna with 15 articles, the third article longer than the fourth and the fourth longer than the second. Mandibles (fig. 11) with the highest left mandible index (1.54) of any of the Australian genera of the Subulitermes branch of the Nasutitermitinae. The closest Australian genus is Macrosubulitermes (fig. 9), with an index of 1.07.
evidence.note: 澳大利亚白蚁属（australitermes）：支撑：「有翅成虫」触角节数与比例、左颚指数及其在澳大利亚支系中的位置。

evidence.quote: Head with a small constriction visible from both the top and side. The profile of the pronotum has a sharp angle close to a right angle between the front lobe and the basal portion.
evidence.note: 澳大利亚白蚁属（australitermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」单型、头部小收缩与前胸背板侧轮廓的近直角。

evidence.quote: SOLDIER: The mandibles lack apical points.
evidence.note: 小锡兰白蚁属（ceylonitermellus）：支撑：「兵蚁」唯一可引性状。

evidence.quote: The left mandible has a characteristically long first plus second marginal tooth. The left mandible index is 0.62.
evidence.note: 小锡兰白蚁属（ceylonitermellus）：支撑：「工蚁」左颚第 1+2 缘齿特别长与指数 0.62。

evidence.quote: The third marginal tooth is proportionately small compared to that of Leucopitermes. The right mandible has a concave outline of the molar plate. The angles between the apical teeth and the first marginal teeth of both mandibles are wider than those of any other related genera in the Oriental region.
evidence.note: 小锡兰白蚁属（ceylonitermellus）：支撑：「工蚁」「鉴别要点」第 3 缘齿小、右颚磨板凹、端齿与第 1 缘齿夹角最宽。

evidence.quote: Minute hairs occur on the frontal tube and vertex that are not so long nor so abundant as in Malagasitermes milloti. A small but distinct constriction at the sides of the head behind the bases of the antennae is visible from above. The mandibles may be with or without points.
evidence.note: 白脸白蚁属（leucopitermes）：支撑「兵蚁」头毛被、缩窄、上颚有或无端尖。

evidence.quote: The mandibular index of the left mandible is 0.56. The notch in front of the third marginal tooth is wide but distinct. The third marginal tooth is proportionately rather wide. The right mandible has a distinct second marginal tooth, with a fairly sharp angle a little less than a right angle separating the first and second marginal teeth.
evidence.note: 白脸白蚁属（leucopitermes）：支撑「工蚁」左颚指数 0.56 及各缘齿/磨板形态。

evidence.quote: The index of the left mandible is 1.06. The second marginal tooth of the right mandible is almost completely regressed, and the outline of the molar plate is somewhat concave. The lack of a distinct third marginal tooth on the left mandible and the reduced second marginal tooth on the right mandible distinguish this genus from all others in the Subulitermes branch in the Oriental region.
evidence.note: 东锥白蚁属（oriensubulitermes）：支撑「工蚁/鉴别要点」左颚指数 1.06 与建属性状。

evidence.quote: The head has a distinct constriction and a rather bulbous rear portion. The frontal tube is conic. The antenna has 12-13 articles. The single soldier of Malagasitermes milloti examined has a distinct but short, sharp, apical point on the right mandible and no apical point on the left mandible.
evidence.note: 马尔加什白蚁属（malagasitermes）：支撑「兵蚁」头形、额突、触角、上颚端尖不对称。

evidence.quote: Both mandibles have proportionately large apical teeth compared to the first marginal teeth, and the cutting edge of the first plus second marginal tooth of the left mandible is undulated. A distinct notch is retained in front of the third marginal tooth of the left mandible. The right mandible has a somewhat rounded second marginal tooth. The mandibular index of the left mandible is 0.66.
evidence.note: 马尔加什白蚁属（malagasitermes）：支撑「工蚁」左颚指数 0.66 与各缘齿形态。

evidence.quote: Fontanelle distinctly forked at the anterior end. Postclypeus much longer than half of the width (length, 0.22 mm.; width, 0.32 mm.). The generic distinctions include the prominent second marginal tooth on the right mandible. The left mandible index is 0.68.
evidence.note: 隐白蚁属（occultitermes）：支撑「有翅成虫」囟分叉、后唇基长宽比、左颚指数 0.68。

evidence.quote: SOLDIER: Dimorphic. The mandibles are without points.
evidence.note: 隐白蚁属（occultitermes）：支撑「兵蚁/鉴别要点」二型兵蚁、上颚无端尖。

evidence.quote: The left mandible index is 1.07 in Macrosubulitermes greavesi and 1.29-1.33 in Subulitermes microsoma.
evidence.note: 大锥白蚁属（macrosubulitermes）：支撑「有翅成虫」左颚指数 1.07。

evidence.quote: The head length divided by the head width is 1.49-1.63 in Macrosubulitermes perlevis, 1.71 in M. greavesi, and 2.27 in Subulitermes microsoma. The head of Macrosubulitermes greavesi is very slightly constricted, with lateral humps just posterior to the base of the frontal projection. The mandibles are without points in both Macrosubulitermes and Subulitermes.
evidence.note: 大锥白蚁属（macrosubulitermes）：支撑「兵蚁」头长宽比、微缩窄、上颚无端尖。

evidence.quote:
Head and pronotum with numerous short bristles 
and a few scattered short hairs. Tergites with short hairs and a few 
sparsely distributed bristles on the sides, but not forming a conspicuous 
marginal row.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫头、前胸背板与腹节的毛被

evidence.quote:
Eye and ocellus large, the ocellus less than 
its width from the ocular suture and longer (0.15 mm.) than the 
diameter of the basal socket of the antenna (0.12 mm.).
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫单眼长 0.15 mm、触角基窝直径 0.12 mm

evidence.quote: The length of the head is 1.44—1.56 mm.
evidence.note: 支撑：本种唯一的种级量度——兵蚁头长 1.44—1.56 mm

evidence.note: 无颚白蚁属（agnathotermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」上颚无端尖、鼻短圆锥形、触角 11-12 节。

evidence.quote: Soldier, —Head, light yellow, straw-colored, nasus reddish-brown, profile of head convex, broadest posteriorly, where margin is rounded, gradually narrowed anteriorly, nasus conical and robust, head with dense long hairs, nasus with dense short hairs. Mandibles with no sharp points.

evidence.quote: Head yellow brown, constricted behind the antennae; thickly covered with bristles. Antennae same color as the head, with 14 segments, the 3d one and one- half times the length of the 2d, the 4th equals the 3d or is very slightly longer. evidence.note: 棱角白蚁属（angularitermes）：支撑：「鉴别要点」「兵蚁」鼻的大小与毛被，以及原作者对其发达程度的判断。

evidence.quote: Head dark brown, sparsely clothed with long hairs; oval, posterior margin behind the eyes angular from above

evidence.quote: Cavitermes seems to be nearest to Mirotermes, s. str. than to any other subgenus but it differs from the typical Mirotermes, s. str. in the ridges along the forehead of the soldier and the hollowed front which suggested the name.

evidence.quote: The mandibles of the soldier are similar in shape and adaptation to those of Mirotermes, s. str.

evidence.quote: The soldier is quite distinct from all the other groups of the genus Mirotermes in that it has a flat forehead. With this exception, I believe it comes closest to the subgenus Mirotermes, s. str. The mandibles are adapted for snapping and have the same form as in Mirotermes, s. str.

evidence.quote: Soldier.—Head yellow, oval from the top with a slight constriction in back of the base of the antennae, profile from base of nose to rear margin convex; smooth except for 4 bristles at base of nose and 2 on the vertex.

evidence.quote: Imago. Cabeça e pronoto com muitos pêlos e umas poucas cerdas longas (figs. 1 - 6). Fontanela alongada, extremidade anterior bifurcada. Olhos grandes. Ocelos mais próximos dos respectivos olhos do que a largura de cada ocelo. Pós-clípeo mais curto do que a metade de sua largura.
evidence.note: 阿特拉斯白蚁属（atlantitermes）：支撑：「有翅成虫」毛被、囟形、眼与单眼、后唇基比例。

evidence.quote: Soldado. Cabeça com pêlos minúsculos, esparsos, e umas poucas cerdas longas (figs. 12 - 15); naso com inúmeros pelos curtos. Cabeça, dorsal (figs. 12 - 13): adelgaçada logo atrás da inserção das antenas, região posterior bulbosa, naso cônico; perfil (figs. 14 - 15): naso também cônico. Mandíbulas sem pontas.
evidence.note: 阿特拉斯白蚁属（atlantitermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」头与鼻的毛被、头壳在触角后变细且后部球状、鼻锥形、上颚无端尖。

evidence.quote: Mandíbulas (figs. 10 - 11, um pouco desgastadas) semelhantes às do alado, mas mandíbula esquerda com margem cortante entre M1+2 e M3 distintamente sinuosa.
evidence.note: 阿特拉斯白蚁属（atlantitermes）：支撑：「工蚁」「鉴别要点」工蚁上颚与有翅成虫相似而左颚切缘明显波状。

sources.title: Caetetermes taquarussu, a new genus and species of Ecuadorian nasute (Isoptera, Termitidae, Nasutitermitinae)
sources.notes: Caetetermes 原始属级描述（Imago. Unknown）；工蚁一节据原文对大型工蚁（major worker）的描述。

evidence.quote: Head capsule sharply constricted (figs. 1-4) behind antennae, posterior region bulbous. Nose long, cylindrical and not specially enlarged at base. Postclypeus oblique, clearly visible in dorsal view (figs. 1-2). Mandibles (figs. 5-6) without points, with a distinct but not sharply defined thinner patch of cuticle at the apex.
evidence.note: 林白蚁属（caetetermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」头壳急剧收缩与后部球状、鼻形、后唇基与上颚端部构造。

evidence.quote: Width of postclypeus/length of postclypeus 3.66-4.89. Left mandible (figs. 9, 12): index 0.49; A shorter than Ml + 2; posterior margin of A almost straight and shorter than the anterior margin of Ml+2; angle, between A and Ml+2 acute; cutting edge of Ml+2 sinuate, separated from M3 by a sharp notch; M3 developed, posterior margin convex;
evidence.note: 林白蚁属（caetetermes）：支撑：「工蚁」后唇基比例、左颚指数、端齿与 M1+2、M3 的关系。
evidence.ocr_note: OCR 把 M1+2 印作 Ml + 2，引文照录。

evidence.quote: Legs long but shorter than the corresponding soldier legs; anterior coxae with a weak hump outside corresponding to the prominent soldier hump
evidence.note: 林白蚁属（caetetermes）：支撑：「工蚁」「鉴别要点」足长与前足基节外侧隆起。

sources.title: A new genus and species of Nasutitermitinae from South America (Isoptera, Termitidae)
sources.notes: Coendutermes 原始属级描述（Alate. Unknown）。

evidence.quote: Head capsule with many hollow glandular bristles scattered over dorsum and sides (figs. 1-2). These are large and well visible erect bristles, brownish in colour and stout, ending in a truncated tip. Non-glandular bristles are apparently absent in the head, except for the apex of the nose.
evidence.note: 箭猪白蚁属（coendutermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」「鉴别要点」腺刚毛形态与「除鼻端外无普通刚毛」。

evidence.quote: Nose conical, slightly turned upwards; tip pointed. Postclypeus weakly oblique, visible in dorsal view. Mandibles each with a discrete hump on apex but without a developed apical point. Antenna (fig. 2) very long, extending well beyond the apex of the nose.

evidence.quote:
From  the  description  and  figure  of  Mathews  ( 1977  : 233-234,  fig.  166  ),  it 
seems  that  the  dentition  of  the  mandibles  of  the  alate  of  Angularitermes  orestes  is 
similar  to  that  of  the  worker. 

Left  mandible  (fig. 55)  : apical  tooth  with  posterior  margin  strongly  concave; 
cutting  edge  between  the  first  + second  marginal  tooth  and  the  third  marginal  tooth 
sinuate;  third  marginal  tooth  very  reduced  and  visible  as  a pointed  projection  in 
front  of  the  molar  tooth;  gap  between  the  third  marginal  tooth  and  the  molar  promi- 
nence narrow;  molar  tooth  developed  and  mostly  hidden  beneath  the  molar  promi- 
nence. 

Right  mandible  (fig.  57)  . apical  tooth  with  posterior  margin  strongly  conca- 
ve; second  marginal  tooth  visible  as  a rounded  projection  at  about  half  distance 
between  the  point  of  the  first  marginal  tooth  and  the  molar  plate;  posterior  margin  of 
the  second  marginal  tooth  concave.
evidence.note: 支撑：左上颚与右上颚齿列的中文改写（端齿、第三缘齿、第二缘齿、臼齿突）

evidence.quote:
The  genus  Angularitermes  still  deserves  a word  of  explanation,  as  the  index 
of  the  alate  left  mandible  is  unknown.  Mathews  ( 1977  : 233  ) gives  a value  of  about 
0.77  for  the  left  mandible  index  of  the  alate  of  A.  orestes,  but  this  was  obtained  by 
dividing  the  distance  between  the  apical  tooth  and  first  + second  marginal  tooth  by 
the  distance  between  the  first  + second  marginal  tooth  and  the  molar  prominence 
( this  was  called  “modified  left  mandible  index”  by  Mathews  ),  instead  of  dividing 
the  first  measurement  above  by  the  distance  between  the  first  + second  marginal 
tooth  and  the  third  marginal  tooth  ( index  of  Emerson  ),  as  adopted  in  this  paper. 
The  “modified  left  mandible  index”  for  the  worker  of  A.  orestes,  the  sole  caste  stu- 
died in  this  paper,  is  approximately  1.15  and  therefore  considerably  higher  than  in 
the  alate.

evidence.quote: Soldier . Dimorphic (Figs. 1 A-D). Mandibles with distinct points. Antennae with 13 articles. Nasus narrow at base, nearly cylindrical. evidence.quote:
Lepidotermes planifacies (Williams) conforms to the generic char- 
acters of Lepidotermes in its minutely granular upper and under 
surfaces of the soldier mandibles from the marginal tooth to the apex 
and fine striations visible in a favorable light near the apex and near 
the marginal tooth. The tooth-like projection of the molar plate of 
the left mandible does not project forward so much as in L. goliathi, 
but projects forward more than in Nitiditermes berghei. The labrum 
of the soldier of Lepidotermes planifacies is not indented in the middle 
so much as in Nitiditermes berghei, nor are the lateral points so sharp. 
The irregular postmentum of the soldier in profile, the sharper front 
in profile, and the equal distance of the left imago-worker mandible 
from the apex to the first marginal tooth compared to the distance 
between the tips of the first and third marginal teeth suggest the possi- 
bility that Lepidotermes planifacies may belong to a new genus ap- 
proaching Fastigitermes.
evidence.note: 支撑：上颚颗粒与条纹、磨板齿突、上唇凹陷

evidence.quote: The genus Ahamitermes was established for a species the soldier caste of which was described as not having mandibular teeth. The characters of the winged adult were defined later from an allied species. An examination of yet another related form indicates that Ahamitermes is best regarded as a subgenus of Hamitermes.

minutely shagreened, with scanty short hairs (Fig. 36).
Eyes small (0.33 diam. ), prominent. Ocelli very small,
contiguous with eyes. A conspicuous frons spot on either
side of the head posterior to transverse suture and in line
with the ocelli and lateral margin of postclypeus. Antennae
of 15 or 16 segments, usually 16; the 3rd often longer and
wider than the 2nd, sometimes 2nd, 3rd and 4th of equal
length; 4th-l4th or 15th progressively longer and wider,
the last segment shorter and narrower than the penultimate
segment. Pronotum wider than head, wider than long, strong-
ly arched, anterior margin with wide and shallow concavity,
sides slightly rounded, posterior margin broadly rounded,
slightly concave in the middle, the margin impressed and
fringed with moderately short hairs, few hairs elsewhere.
Wings moderately long and narrow, densely covered with scale-
like micrasters, especially on veins.

Dealated adult
A large species, very hairy, some of the hairs
markedly long. Head, thorax and tergites of abdomen
argus brown; legs, antennae and sternites of abdomen
buckthorn brown; clypeus ochraceous-tawny. Head (Fig.

Fontanelle linear. Eyes of moderate size, prominent.
Ocelli large, broadly oval, inner margin markedly elevated,
a little less than their short diameter from the eyes.
Antennae long, of 15 segments; 3rd very long, not much
shorter than Ist; 2nd very small; 4th and sth long and
narrow, shorter and narrower than 3rd, the remaining seg-
ments long. Apical tooth of mandibles much longer than,
and widely separated from, the next. Postclypeus small,
half as long as wide (0.25 x 0.50). Pronotum very large,
markedly wider than long, strongly arched, markedly con-
cave .in front, sides sloping to the broadly rounded
posterior margin. Posterior margin of meso- and meta-
notum narrow and deeply emarginate.
It is possible that the termite described above is
the same as M. broomensis , only the soldier of which is
known.

evidence.quote: Head small, cylindrical, height almost equal to width, frons sloping toward clypeus at about 45-degree angle. Frontal gland very small; fontanelle round, very small, about 0.014-0.019 mm. in diameter, situated just above frontal slope.

evidence.quote: Labrum very large and wide, wider than long, asymmetrical, tilted upward; anterior region with wide hyaline tip; underside with posterior median sclerotized protrusion pointing downward.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上唇形态

evidence.quote: Mandibles rather strongly curved, asymmetrical. Left mandible slightly longer than right; inner cutting edge beginning at tip with distinct and regular serrations up to one-third or one-half the length, ending with four progressively larger teeth; posterior margin of third and fourth tooth long; small pointed projection at base of fourth tooth.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁左颚锯齿与齿列

evidence.quote: Right mandible more sharply curved inward than left; inner margin smooth dorsally, narrow groove running from near base to tip, ventral margin of groove finely serrated; one or two very tiny thornlike points at base. Pronotum saddle-shaped, narrower than head. Antennae with 12 articles. Tibial spurs 3:2:2.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁右颚、前胸背板、触角、胫距

evidence.quote: Left mandible (fig. 1) with short apical tooth; posterior margin of fused first plus second marginal tooth longer than apical tooth, with almost straight cutting edge, joining evenly (without a distinct angle) with anterior margin of third marginal tooth; mandible index LA/Li .28;
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁左颚齿列与颚指数 LA/Li 0.28

evidence.quote: fourth marginal tooth small, faintly visible from above, almost hidden behind molar prominence; molar plate with a few (4-5) grinding ridges.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁左颚第4缘齿与臼齿板

evidence.quote: Our study confirms that Labritermes is most closely related to Foraminitermes, as the two genera share several synapomorphic characters.
evidence.note: 支撑：与 Foraminitermes 的近缘关系

evidence.quote: In the soldier of each of these genera, the labrum has a hyaline tip; the upper inner cutting edge of the left mandible is finely serrated, with blunt teeth appearing as crenulations below the serrations; and the inner margin of the right mandible is smooth and without teeth, the base of its molar region with one or two very tiny, pointed, thornlike spines or projections.

evidence.quote: The new genus is distinguished from other morphologically related genera by having an extremely elongated first proctodeal segment, forming a spiral in the distal region of the abdomen, completing a full turn along the body axis before connecting to P3 on the right side, in ventral view (Figure 2C).

evidence.quote: Furthermore, the new genus has an unarmed enteric valve (Figure 2G,H), a characteristic also observed in genera such as Mangolditermes and Tucupitermes. However, none of these genera have spines directed toward P1 (Figure 2G,H).
evidence.note: 支撑：鉴别要点——无刺肠瓣 + 棘朝向 P1。

evidence.quote: Head capsule light yellow with many short and sparse setae distributed throughout the length of the head capsule (Figure 1A,B). Fontanelle conspicuous, oval in shape, and white (Figure 1B). Postclypeus appears slightly inflated, with only a few short setae (Figure 1A,B).
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头部外部形态。

evidence.quote: Labrum convex, with some setae that are thicker than those of the head capsule (Figure 1B). Antenna with 13 antennomeres, with antennomere I>II, III < others (Figure 1A,B).
evidence.note: 支撑：上唇、触角 13 节。

evidence.quote: Left mandible with apical tooth slightly shorter than M1+2 (Figure 1C); typical Neotropical Apicotermitinae incision pronounced between M1+2 and M3; tooth M3 not very prominent; molar process completely occluded by the molar prominence, which projects to the same length as M1 + 2 (Figure 1C).
evidence.note: 支撑：左颚齿列与臼齿突。

evidence.quote: P1 extremely elongated and visible in all four perspectives (Figure 2A-D), starting on the left side of the body and forming a pronounced S-shape in the left lateral view (Figure 2D). P1 very elongated, sinuous in left lateral view (Figure 2D), forming a complete loop ventrally.
evidence.note: 支撑：消化管 P1 走向。

evidence.quote: It is inserted into P3 on a well-marked enteric valve seating (Figure 2F). Enteric valve seating unlobed and funnel-shaped (Figure 2C,F).
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣座不分叶、漏斗状。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve unarmed, with six symmetrical lobes, each ornamented with spines in the proximal median region and oriented toward P1 (Figure 2G,H). The size of the spines gradually decreases as they extend away from the apex of the enteric valve (Figure 2G,H).
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣无刺、六瓣、棘朝向 P1。

evidence.quote: We describe Scheffrahnitermes ubuntu, gen. and sp. nov., a new Apicotermitinae genus and species characterized by the presence of two asymmetrical sclerotized armed plates on the enteric valve seating (EVS), the EVS forming a small unique sac, and by workers that turn reddish when preserved in alcohol.
evidence.note: 属级鉴别特征（摘要）

evidence.quote: Fontanelle conspicuous, subcircular (Figure 1B); medium spot conspicuous (Figure 1B); eyes circular, ocelli oval-shaped separated from the eye by less than its diameter (Figure 1A).
evidence.note: 有翅成虫头部（囟门/复眼/单眼）

evidence.quote: Left mandible with an apical tooth and M1+2 of the same size; M3 triangular with a sharp edge; presence of a gap between the M3 and a prominent premolar process. Right mandible with apical tooth and M1 almost of the same size; M2 triangular with sharp edges (Figure 1D).
evidence.note: 有翅成虫上颚

evidence.quote: Head capsule round in dorsal view, covered with very short hairs and bristles of short, medium and long size (Figure 1B); head capsule dark brown, lighter around the antennae. Antennae with 15 articles (formula 2>3<4=5).
evidence.note: 有翅成虫头壳与触角

evidence.quote: Antenna with 12-14 segments (formula 2>3=4<5), lightly colored near the base and gradually darker toward the tip.
evidence.note: 工蚁触角

evidence.quote: Enteric valve (EV) with six columnar cushions; each cushion has a short spine near its base and is covered with small scales; scales are sub-trapezoidal in the central area of the cushion and sub-rectangular marginally; small spines are present along the border of the scales, pointing toward the direction of the P3 (Figure 3B).
evidence.note: 肠瓣结构

evidence.quote: Enteric valve seating (EVS) short, forming a small sac visible in ventral and right views (Figure 3C,E); internally, the EVS has two asymmetrical sclerotized plates covered with spines going toward the P3 and spines between plates, and the bigger plate is aligned with the sac on the EVS (Figure 3A).
evidence.note: 肠瓣座结构（属级鉴别核心）

evidence.quote: P3 with an isthmus on the left side of the body, in junction with P4 (Figure 3E). P4 forming a U turn behind the mixed segment, ending dorsally in an enlarged P5 (Figure 3E).
evidence.note: 后肠盘绕（P3/P4/P5）

evidence.quote: Scheffrahnitermes can be easily distinguished from all other known neotropical Apicotermitinae by a unique set of characters, including a singular EVS, internally sclerotized and spiny, and externally forming a small sac, and the workers that turn red when preserved in alcohol.
evidence.note: 属级比较诊断

evidence.quote: Soldier (figs. 3, 7, 8): Tergites a little paler yellow than the head and pronotum; abdomen often gray from the contents of the intestines. Head, pronotum, and tergites with scattered bristles, rather sparse on the head; a few short, almost invisible, hairs on the head and postmentum.
evidence.note: 支撑：Procornitermes araujoi 兵蚁体色与毛被的原始描述

evidence.quote: Comparisons: Differs from all other described species of this genus in the three sharply pointed projections of the labrum (fig. 1A). Closest to P. araujoi, from which it differs in the sharper side points of the labrum, the straighter and more parallel sides of the head, the somewhat more concave sides of the postmentum, and the proportionately shorter hind tibia.
evidence.note: 支撑：Procornitermes triacifer 兵蚁的鉴别特征

evidence.quote: Comparisons: This species seems to be the only one (except for one specimen of P. araujoi) with three apical spurs on the fore tibia of both imago and soldier. This is a primitive character compared to the 2:2:2 arrangement in all the other species (one exception already noted). P. striatus is also the only species with 15 articles in the antenna of the imago and 14 articles in the antenna of the soldier.
evidence.note: 支撑：Procornitermes striatus 胫距式与触角节数的鉴别特征

evidence.quote: Head somewhat rectangular, the sides fairly straight and parallel. Frontal tube proportionately long, reaching the front of the postclypeus from above. Postmentum with the narrow portion about half the width of the widest portion (0.28-0.30:0.58-0.63 mm.).
evidence.note: 支撑：Procornitermes romani 兵蚁头部与后颏的原始描述与量度

evidence.quote: Comparisons: Procornitermes cornutus has the angle of the notch of the right mandible greater than a right angle (fig. 2C), and the sides of the head are more angular. P. romani has the sides of the head straighter and more parallel (fig. 10), and the head is thicker (1.62-1.66 mm.).
evidence.note: 支撑：Procornitermes lespesii 兵蚁与近缘种的鉴别

evidence.quote: Soldier (figs. 3, 19-22): Head yellowish, the pronotum a little lighter than the head; tergites a little lighter than the pronotum; intestinal contents often producing a dirt color. Head sparsely covered with bristles and numerous fairly long hairs about half of the length of the bristles not, however, forming a contrasting mat of short hair;
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁体色、毛被与头形描述

evidence.quote: Comparisons: Cornitermes snyderi differs from other described imagoes in the genus in the vertical position of the ocellus and the small white portion of the ocellus visible from above.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫的鉴别特征（单眼位置）

evidence.quote: Comparisons: The soldiers from the type colony from Lago Rogagua have a more bulging postmentum in profile, and the frontal tube is not so curved on the under side as in the paratype soldiers from Cachuela Esperanza.
evidence.note: 支撑：两产地兵蚁后颏与额管的形态差异

evidence.quote: Imago: Described by Silvestri, but not available for study by the author.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫描述缺失（Silvestri 描述过，本文作者未获标本）

evidence.quote: Soldier: Head, pronotum, and abdomen yellowish; pronotum a little paler than head; abdomen with grayish appearance from gut contents. Head sparsely covered with bristles, no short hair visible;
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁体色与毛被

evidence.quote: Comparisons: Although the cotype soldiers of C. acignathus, subsp. costaricensis Snyder, from Hamburg Farm, Costa Rica, are somewhat larger than the soldiers from numerous colonies of C. walkeri from Panama and one colony from Estrella, Costa Rica, the differences are insufficient in the author’s opinion to warrant the separation of two subspecies.
evidence.note: 支撑：costaricensis 亚种并入本种的处理

evidence.quote: Comparisons: There is a considerable variation in the mean size of the soldiers from different colonies. For example, the head width of 35 specimens from various Guiana localities (except Itabu Creek) averaged 2.59 mm., 23 specimens from Itabu Creek, British Guiana, averaged 3.07 mm., six specimens from Lago Poraquequare, Manaos, Brazil, averaged 3.12 mm., five specimens from Cachuela Esperanza, Bolivia, averaged 2.85 mm.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头宽的居群间变异（2.59—3.12 mm）

evidence.quote: Comparisons: The arrangement of the bristles and hairs on the head distinguishes this species from all others in the genus.
evidence.note: 支撑：毛被排列为本种唯一鉴别特征

evidence.quote: Comparisons: The lateral angles of the labrum are sharper in C. weberi than in any other described soldier with a dense mat of short hair on the head.
evidence.note: 支撑：上唇侧角为本种鉴别特征

evidence.quote: Comparisons: All other species of the genus with a mat of short hair covering the head have straighter and more parallel sides of the head, with a sharper curve joining the sides and the hind margin.
evidence.note: 支撑：头形与其他具短毛毯种的对比

evidence.quote: Comparisons: Close to C. bequaerti (fig. 32), but C. villosus has a more dense mat of short hair on the head, the sides of the head converge more towards the front, and the front margin of the pronotum is more distinctly emarginate.
evidence.note: 支撑：与 C. bequaerti 的鉴别

evidence.quote: Comparisons: Comitermes incisus (fig. 29) is close, but the sides and hind angles of the head are rounder, the pronotum is more deeply emarginate in front, the frontal tube is thicker at the base, and the notch of the left mandible is closer to the tip of the mandible.
evidence.note: 支撑：与 C. incisus 的鉴别（原文印作 Comitermes）

evidence.quote: Comparisons: A single colony from Piraputanga, Mato Grosso, Brazil, contained one soldier of normal size and a number of markedly smaller soldiers. evidence.note: 支撑：同巢大、小兵蚁并存及对量度均值的影响

evidence.quote: Comparisons: Closest to C. villosus from which it differs in the wider angle of the notch of the right mandible, and in the smaller size.
evidence.note: 支撑：与 C. villosus 的鉴别

sources.title: New species of the genus Glyptotermes Froggatt from the Papuan, Oriental, Ethiopian, and Neotropical regions (Isoptera, Kalotermitidae)

evidence.quote: The species is named in honor of the late Dr. K. P. Schmidt, Chief Curator of Zoology, Chicago Natural History Museum, Chicago, Illinois.
evidence.locator: American Museum Novitates No.2089, schmidti 词源段
evidence.note: 支撑：schmidti 纪念 Karl Patterson Schmidt

evidence.quote: Glyptotermes guamensis is close to G. xantholabrum Hill, but can be distinguished from it in the following respects: the sides of the head are almost parallel, the postmentum is more constricted in the posterior half, and the sides of the pronotum are convex.
evidence.note: 支撑：与 G. xantholabrum 的鉴别（头侧近平行、后颏后半收缩、前胸背板侧缘凸）

evidence.quote: Glyptotermes lighti closely resembles G. schmidti, new species, and G. palauensis, new species. In Glyptotermes schmidti the head is smaller, the forehead is steeper, the mandibles are shorter, with their outer bases distinctly humped, and the postmentum is less constricted.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁与 G. schmidti、G. palauensis 的鉴别

evidence.quote: Glyptotermes concavifrons closely resembles G. dilatatus (Bugnion and Popoff), but differs as follows: the postmentum is less constricted in the middle, and the anterolateral corners of the pronotum are less broadly rounded.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁与 G. dilatatus 的鉴别（后颏中部收缩较弱、前胸背板前侧角圆度较小）

evidence.quote: It is distinguishable from G. dilatatus as follows: it has a depressed and concave forehead and shorter mandibles, the first marginal tooth of the left mandible is closer to the tip of the apical tooth, the postmentum is less constricted in the middle, and the pronotum is broader, with its posterolateral margins slightly concave.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁与 G. dilatatus 的鉴别（额凹、上颚短、左颚第 1 缘齿更近端齿、后颏收缩弱、前胸背板更宽）

evidence.quote: Glyptotermes parki, new species, is smaller throughout, and the anterodorsal prominences on its forehead are not so prominent. Glyptotermes longuisculus, new species, is smaller in all respects, and the anterodorsal prominences on its forehead are more feeble.
evidence.note: 支撑：与 G. parki、G. longuisculus 的鉴别

evidence.quote: Glyptotermes ignotus Wilkinson closely resembles G. jurioni, but can be distinguished from it as follows: it has a longer and broader head, the mandible has a prominent basal hump, and the pronotum is broader, with its anterior margin concave and its posterolateral margins more broadly rounded.
evidence.note: 支撑：与 G. ignotus 的鉴别（头、上颚基瘤、前胸背板形状）

evidence.quote: Glyptotermes jurioni, new species, G. sinomalatus, new species, and G. ueleensis Coaton are smaller in all measurements. In G. insulanus Silvestri the forewing is shorter and narrower, the eye shape is different, the ocellus is larger, the anterolateral corners of the pronotum are narrower, and the antenna has 12 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：与 G. jurioni、G. sinomalatus、G. ueleensis、G. insulanus 的量度与形态鉴别

evidence.quote: In the Neotropical Region the imago of Glyptotermes longipennis has the longest wings. It differs from G. hospitalis Emerson in having larger and more prominent eyes, more broadly rounded anterolateral corners of the pronotum, and a longer tibia. Glyptotermes contracticornis (Snyder) has shorter and narrower wings and a broader pronotum, with its posterolateral margins rounded.
evidence.note: 支撑：新翅地区有翅成虫以本种翅最长，及与 G. hospitalis、G. contracticornis 的鉴别

evidence.quote: Head elongate; sides parallel, slightly narrow in front; forehead in profile nearly vertical, in some specimens sloping at an angle; bilobed, with a deep and narrow incision in middle.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头部形状与额部双叶、中部深窄切口

Mandibles short, outer bases slightly humped; left mandible with three marginal teeth, first and second close to each other, third far removed with a broad base, posterior margin of second and anterior margin of third forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with two marginal teeth, second very faint, point of first marginal tooth 0.30 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Mandibles short, outer bases distinctly humped; left mandible with three faint marginal teeth, first and second close to each other, posterior margin of second and anterior margin of third forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with two marginal teeth (tip broken in holotype specimen). Postmentum short; not strongly constricted in middle. Antenna with 11 articles; second longer than third or fourth, third shorter than fourth.

Y suture clearly visible. Eyes small. Labrum with posterolateral sides parallel, anteriorly sides converging into a blunt point. Mandibles short, outer margins at bases uneven; left mandible with three marginal teeth; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.30 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Labrum with sides converging in front; anterior margin blunt. Mandibles short, outer margins sinuate at bases; left mandible with three marginal teeth, posterior margin of second and anterior margin of third forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.24 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Y suture faint. Eyes small. Mandibles stout, outer margins with slight dent in middle; left mandible with three marginal teeth, first narrow-based, second and third broad-based; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.29 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Head stocky; sides slightly converging anteriorly; forehead in profile nearly vertical, middle portion sloping at an angle of about 50 degrees; conspicuously indented in middle, forming two rounded lobes. Y suture visible. Eyes oval. Mandibles stout, with a basal hump at outer bases; left mandible with three marginal teeth; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.38 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Head long, narrow posteriorly, broadest anteriorly; frons in middle slightly depressed; in profile sloping at an angle of approximately 45 degrees. Y suture visible as a faint line. Eyes small, faint. Labrum small, sides straight, anterior margin round. Mandibles short and stout, outer margins almost even; left mandible with three very small marginal teeth, which resemble crenulations, first tooth largest; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.35 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Mandibles short, with a very slight hump at outer bases; left mandible with three marginal teeth, first tooth narrow-based, second and third broad-based; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.21-0.25 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Head short, thick, and truncate; sides slightly converging in front; frontal region vertical, with a depression on each side; forehead bilobed, with a broad and deep incision in middle; lobes broadly rounded and margins rough; a small prominence below antennal socket. Eyes small, oval. Mandibles short, broad at bases; left mandible with three small marginal teeth; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.21 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Head long and thick; sides somewhat parallel; forehead in front vertical, distinctly bilobed, with a deep incision in middle; margin of lobes rough; a faint ridge above and in front of antennal socket. Eyes small. Mandibles short and stout, outer margins with a faint basal hump; left mandible with three marginal teeth, first tooth narrow-based, second and third broad-based; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.25 mm. from tip of apical tooth.

Head elongate, slightly narrower posteriorly; anterodorsal prominences distinct, pointed; frons depressed and concave. Eyes large, suboval. Labrum with anterior margin straight. Mandibles long, outer bases humped; left mandible with three marginal teeth, first subconical, second with posterior margin concave; right mandible with two marginal teeth, point of first marginal tooth 0.38 mm. from tip of apical tooth. Postmentum shaped as in figure, less than twice as wide in broadest part as in narrowest.

evidence.quote: Foraging termites of H. tenuis were captured in underground cardboard traps over 12 months from three field colonies (A, B, and C). The colonies were located in Rio Claro (22° 23′ 43″ S, 47° 32′ 39″ W), Sao Paulo, Brazil.

evidence.quote: Termite species diversity, frequency of occurrence and functional diversity in Charles Darwin National Park, a savanna woodland reserve in tropical northern Australia, were assessed. evidence.note: 支撑草稿：记录 16 种、9 属、3 科；E. taylori 为开阔稀树草原生境首次记录，M. errator 为北澳稀树草原首次正式记录。

evidence.quote: Under the term of sociotomy, (or fission of the society) we describe a curious social behaviour of two African Termites: Anoplotermes sp. and Trinervitermes bettonianus.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：把两种非洲白蚁（Anoplotermes sp. 与 T. bettonianus）的群体分裂称为 sociotomy。

evidence.note: 支撑草稿：队伍在白天离巢、含王室配偶，且只占原群体的一小部分。

evidence.quote: After having covered a greater or lesser distance, each column breaks into several portions, each of which remains alone, scoops out (Anoplotermes) or builds (Trinervitermes) a nest which becomes the foundation of a new society.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：每列分裂为若干小群，各自挖出（Anoplotermes）或建造（Trinervitermes）新巢作为新群体起点。

evidence.note: 支撑草稿：补充生殖蚁通过幼态持续频繁产生；迁徙队伍涵盖所有品级包括具功能生殖蚁与有翅个体。

evidence.quote: The winged individuals, which normally only issue from the nest to undertake their swarming flight have their genetic behaviour abolished and can be seen creeping on the surface of the ground carrying larvae. The Anoplotermes workers can even acquire the behaviour of soldiers.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：有翅个体在地面爬行并搬运幼虫；解甲白蚁属工蚁甚至表现出兵蚁行为。

evidence.quote: For the first time, the usefulness of the nasuti in defending the nest is firmly established, and so is the importance of the organization of the group in the defence against the assailants.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：作者首次以确凿观察确认象鼻兵蚁（nasuti）在防御中的作用。

evidence.quote: Krishnacapritermes Chhotani (Isoptera: Termitidae) is one of the endemic termite genera from the Western Ghats of India. Under the genus, only two species Krishnacapritermes maitii Chhotani and Krishnacapritermes thakuri Chhotani were known earlier. The present study describes two new species, Krishnacapritermes dineshan Amina and Rajmohana sp. nov. and Krishnacapritermes manikandan Amina and Rajmohana sp. nov. from the higher elevation hill ranges of Western Ghats part of Kerala. DNA barcodes based on cytochrome oxidase I genes were generated for K. thakuri and K. dineshan from multiple locations and tested for phylogenetic relationships. The paper provides a dichotomous key for the four species of Krishnacapritermes and a species distribution map, along with data on the extension of distribution range for K. maitii and K. thakuri. Comments on intracolonial variability of the hyaline lateral points or processes of the labrum in soldier caste are included. Pericapritermes travancorensis Mathew and Ipe syn. nov. is treated as a junior synonym of K. thakuri.http://www.zoobank.org/urn:lsid:zoobank.org:pub:E2F050B5-2F85-415A-A446-4DC7FCDA1068

evidence.quote: Constrictotermes sp. nests are frequently inhabited by colonies of Inquilinitermes microcerus. In this association, I. microcerus colonies usually establish their colonies spatially isolated from Constrictotermes colonies. Here, we investigated whether the apparent spatial isolation of I. microcerus colonies in Constrictotermes nests should be related to their needs (e.g. feeding) in relation to the central part of the nest or to a possible stress provoked by the presence of the host. For this, survival and walking behavior bioassays were performed to test the hypothesis that the survivorship of inquilines is: (i) reduced in the presence of host, mainly of those from different nests, (ii) increased in contact with inner walls compared with external walls; and that the distance walked and walking velocity of inquiline is: (iii) increased in the presence of the host and (iv) reduced in contact with the internal walls compared with external walls of host nest.
evidence.note: 支撑：客白蚁（Inquilinitermes microcerus）在缩白蚁（Constrictotermes）巢中的回避行为与接触存活差异；仅有摘要，未读全文（摘要第 1/2 段）

evidence.quote: The mean time to death of inquiline workers is lower in contact with host (independently from the same or different nest) compared with control and the mean time to death of inquiline workers is lower in contact with external walls of host nest compared with control group and the inner walls. The distance walked and walking velocity of inquiline workers in contact with their hosts (from the same or different nest) did not differ from control, however, these parameters were reduced when workers were in contact with inner and external walls compared with control. In general, our results showed that I. microcerus adopt behavioral strategies to avoid perception by its host.
